description:
Welcome on board. And join for a sailing adventure like no other. You will leave the land lubbers far behind and begin an exciting journey of new experiences and discoveries.

Midday and Sunset

Cruise three or four miles offshore and heave to, lower the swim platform and take a long leisurely swim while drinks and snacks on board are prepared. The perfect afternoon break to explore the blue waters.

Or join us in the evening for Barcelona’s most spectacular light shows.
To see the finest sunset in Barcelona, you must climb the mountains or go out to the sea. The heavens extend limitlessly above you as you watch the sun dip slowly behind the city skyline and the mountains.

You will have your own professional skipper and a top notch sailing yacht. Your journey will be both adventurous, enjoyable and relaxing.

First we will show you around the yacht and prepare for departure. We determine the itinerary together and set sail! You are more than welcome to get involved in the running of the yacht and even planning and navigation.

Our trip starts from the very heart of the city. So before leaving the spectacular marina you will see Barcelona's waterfront as nobody else does. Afterwards we leave the port behind and head for the open sea. You will marvel the Barcelona skyline, wonder the beachfront and enjoy the stunning open blue waters.
locationDescription: You will join us on our fully equipped 42-foot yacht. Our berth is in the most spectacular port of Barcelona: Marina Port Vell, located in the center. You will have a stunning view on the historic waterfront before leaving our marina. Afterwards we set sail along Barcelona's coast line and head towards open sea. You will absorb the views of the skyline, see the waterfront and enjoy the Mediterranean blue waters.

reviews.text: Very nice views! Chill boat ride with tapas and drinks. If your lucky, you might stop for a swim. Don’t hesitate to ask!
This was such a fun experience. We absolutely loved our guide who made sure we saw all the great views and ensured we had time for a quick swim.
Great experience, it started off quite mild but we ended up enjoying the experience with the sunset in the background and making new friends. Overall would recommend to first timers.

Highly recommended.
Confident and experienced skipper along with very helpful first mate
Made this a very enjoyable and entertaining excursion. You will be in good hands with this crew.
Highly recommend this experience! Eduardo and Rodrigo were so friendly and took excellent care of us. They kept the snacks and cava flowing! We’ll definitely do this again the next time we return.
Had a really nice afternoon.. would 100% go again and recommend anyone considering going to do so! The sun was shining, a few beers and a swim with good vibes all round.

Great experience! Aileen our skipper (not sure if that’s how it’s spelled) and Rodrigo were friendly and experienced. We weren’t able to swim as the water was too choppy but this is the perfect trip to take if you want a relaxed afternoon with snacks and drinks and a beautiful view. Would 100% recommend.

Honestly couldn’t recommend this enough! Eduardo and the Italian lady with him (I’ve forgotten her name!) were so helpful, bringing us drinks while we sat at the front of the boat, asking us about how we’re finding Barcelona! I couldn’t recommend this enough, a great way to spend your time, relax and enjoy a glass of wine or a beer on a beautiful boat!

Thanks again
So so fun! Generous snacks and drinks and an easy environment for making friends. A beautiful evening. Varvara was very warm and welcoming and made us all feel at home.

This experience is totally worth the money! My husband and I went on a very cloudy day with absolutely no sun and we still had the best time. Their was so much to drink it kept the good times going. They also provided snacks, music, and good conversation. It was a highlight of my trip.

Nice likeable woman who loves what she does. Everything was as described, there were snacks and drinks for meals. Once you are on the open sea you don't even want to go back. Superb views of the Barcelona skyline.

Vicky was absolutely INCREDIBLE! She went above and beyond to provide snacks/drinks, include us in sailing the boat, and keeping us comfortable at all times. Wayyyyy better than expected. My friend and I also met a couple others who we grabbed lunch with right after. I was hoping we could have swam, but the water was too choppy.
Very good tour, different from what we had found in barcelona so far, it was very worth it and we would do it again for sure

Experience was a nice way to explore the marina and be out in the water. There’s not really a true sunset like you’d expect but the value for what you get is good. Our captain was very nice and we enjoyed talking to him and the other guests. I recommend if you want to get out on the water.

We took the sunset cruise and it was perfect. Hosts/captains were excellent. Gave info and were good guides. Sunset time was wonderful. Even though it was a little chilly- we still enjoyed jumping in the water. Over all great experience. Definitely go if you have a chance.

Thank you so much !! Me n my friend had really great time .. the two host was superrr niceee and accomodating !! They took care of us real well !!

Everyone in the boat was really great , the food and drinks were nice and we had sucha nice picture moment as well !!

Would defo reccomen this !!

A great way to see the sights of Barcelona from the water! Great communication with the guide so finding the location was nice and simple. The boat was not over-sold so there was room for everyone to sit compared to other boats we saw going by that were absolutely crammed. It was a small group and i intimate experience. Harry was the best!! He made sure to review safety measures to make everyone feel comfortable and then got the party started with cava, wines, beer, non-alcoholic drinks and a delicious charcuterie board. He made sure to be attentive to refills as wanted. Definitely recommend this experience!

I think the Host is not enjoying doing this Tours like when he first started. He is just annoyed with people not following his instructions and most of the time people just don’t listen to his storys. He was ignored a lot of times.

This is a fun excursion if you don't want to be on the water for too long. It's a 2 hour sail with the option to stop to swim briefly if the weather allows. Our two crew members (I forget their names) were personable and funny. They give you drinks and snacks and are knowledgeable about the area. Generally just a laid back, good time.

Such a great value for the cost! We booked last minute but the hosts were super accommodating. Great views, snacks, and drinks. Jack and his assistant were making sure we had everything we needed and were also great photographers when we asked if they could take some pictures for us. Would highly recommend!
Beautiful boat, and even friendlier hosts. Couldn’t have asked for a better experience to relax and take in the views from the water!

It's so nice to discover Barcelona from the water and it⛵️'s indescribably beautiful on a sailboat. Our skipper was very friendly, funny and above all, she also impressed with her professionalism. The drive is fun and a lasting experience. THANK YOU !!!!
I booked this as a private tour for myself and my husband. We had a great time and it was better than we expected! We’d definitely do this again!
The experience was amazing!! We enjoyed the sailing and sun bathing. Also we met so many interesting people and had an amazing time together.
We enjoyed our time on the boat ride. We met some wonderful people who we then grabbed drinks with after! They had snacks and drinks for us on board and the driver was amazing!

This was a great experience and a great value. Truly the best way to see a Barcelona sunset. The boat was large enough to be safe and comfortable (with a bathroom below deck), but small enough to keep it a fairly intimate experience. We had 9 guests and 2 crew and were probably at capacity. Great interactions with other guests and enough space for each party to have their own experience I'd definitely do this again.

Truly an amazing experience - we all had SO much fun and our hosts (Frederica and Vicki) really helped elevate our time on the boat. They were fun, personable, and helpful! We had snacks (meats, cheeses, delicious olives) and unlimited drinks (cava was so good!). The sea was rough so we didn’t get to swim, but our hosts made us all feel comfortable even with the rougher waters (some people were nervous about being on the boat). We even got a chance to test our sailing skills and help steer! Would definitely recommend this to anyone in Barcelona!
Amazing! Juan and pella were very informative and provided an amazing experience despite choppy waters. We even had an engagement on the boat and it was a great experience for them (and us)!
Such a lovely host and a wonderful time. Varvara made every effort to accommodate the group, especially after poor weather made going out to open sea unsafe.
We weren’t able to go out to see because of the waves but it was still an amazing experience with a beautiful sunset. Definitely recommend

This was great! Started out w some drinks and snacks and enjoyed time on the water. Due to the weather, we were not able to go out to sea very far and swim in the water, but the host made sure we still enjoyed our time on her boat. Would recommend!
Wonderful experience. Ian and July made us feel welcome and service was impeccable! Food and drinks were great. It was a great way to relax and enjoy the water.

Our tour guide and tris was great.
Ian was our tour guide and was very friendly.
Just wish the tour was a bit longer.
Otherwise the food and drinks were pretty nice too.
We got to also jump in the water and go for a nice swim :)
It’s a good tour to try if you’re in Barcelona !
What a wonderful crew, boat, and sail! The staff were friendly and helpful, the wine and snacks lovely. It was a gem of a trip. Highly recommend them!
Such a trip experience! The skipper and crew were both super nice and the sail was beautiful! Also a great opportunity to meet other travelers

This was a relaxing sunset cruise around the harbor. The crew was very nice and they kept the cava flowing. We were able to move around the boat as we wanted, but felt safe (and the crew was very clear with instructions to help ensure no one would get hurt). We also had fun ogling all of the large yachts in the harbor as we were returning to port. You can look them up online to see what billionaires own them and how much they cost- crazy money!
What a great way to experience Barcelona! We took the sunset cruise our first day in the city and it was beyond beautiful. Highly recommend.
Great fresh evening away from the crowds. Beautiful sunset and smaller group was a nice touch. Would highly recommended and most definitely would do it again.

A truly amazing and unforgettable experience! Vickey and crew did a fantastic job making sure everyone was comfortable and had a cold drink at all times. They even were nice enough to offer and allow me to drive the sailboat for a bit. Absolutely once in a lifetime experience.

This sailing excursion will be a highlight for your time in Barcelona and at a great value. The skippers are very personable and friendly and were my favorite part of the experience. The day we sailed was quite windy but was an adventure nonetheless.

Highly recommend this trip. We had a great time with Skipper Victoria and Oriol. We were well looked-after (particular shout-out for the cava and olives, but there were lots of other options to enjoy), and got to experience some proper sea sailing. It was a lovely sized group, perfect for the boat, and those who wanted got the chance to steer - calmly and ably assisted by our skipper. I would DEFINITELY do this again.

Note of caution: we had to board barefoot, so if you care what your feet look, you might want to think ahead!

Who doesn't love a fun time on the a boat? My friend and I had a wonderful experience. Almost wished I could've jumped off the boat to swim in the water. Unfortunately it wasn't quite hot enough for that. It's a nice intimate time to get to know your group and the guide themselves. Nothing felt forced, and everyone just wanted to relax, sip wine, eat charcuterie, and take pictures at the front of the boat. You get a beautiful view of Barcelona once you get far enough. Eat something before you come on board. They offer a small charcuterie spread and it may not fill you. Also, pack your gravol if you get sea sick! Depending the on the water, it gets pretty bumpy. I found it fun though, haha! I would recommend this if you want some down time from the bustle of the city for a few hours. :)

We were told to come strictly in 15 minutes, as a result the host himself came late , in the end everyone waited, the sunset was missed. The drinks and snacks were fine, but we weren't lucky with the weather and it was windy and lots of waves. Even the port was not calm, but our captains decided to still take us from the port and to the far open sea through large waves and the approaching thunderstorm. It was scary and unsafe. We planned a quiet walk with wine at sunset, in the end there was an extreme travel in the dark. If we wanted to be extreme and sailing, we would choose accordingly,but this place was promised in a completely different format.
It's an excellent trip, they are very friendly and certainly offer you everything they can, only the weather situation is complicated, but definitely an experience that I would repeat.

On the day we had to take the experience, we had to make sure that the sea was a little unresponsive to welcoming us inside, so our captain made the decision not to take any chances, yet they made sure we had a great time with snacks and drinks. The afternoon was fun
Loveliest way to spend the afternoon in Barcelona! Eduardo and Rodrigo were the kindest hosts and it was so relaxing to lay out in the sun while cruising around the coast. Highly recommend!
Eduardo and Rodrigo were warm, wonderful hosts, ensuring everyone was comfortable and had their drinks/snacks properly filled, and sharing in some fun conversations. Would recommend!

The boat ride was comfortable and the view was amazing. The unlimited drinks and snacks were also such a great amenity. We had an excellent group during our excursion that really made the experience a fun night.

We had a sailing night with Tom and Jerry! They were such a blast, they told us such good stories & fun facts. They were also super hospitable, they made sure we were always comfortable, with food and drinks. They really made this experience our BEST in Barcelona. If you’re reading this trying to make a decision to book—BOOK! It will be the highlight of your trip. And also the people that we met on our boat were amazing! They definitely made the boat tour too (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) , will do this everytime I’m back! Thank you :)

Had a fun time and was happy with how open the tour guide was to let us roam around the boat and basically have unlimited Cava and snacks! Had a great time meeting new people and seeing the beautiful city from the water.

Great experience! Would recommend to anyone who wants to experience a different side of Barcelona. We came with a large group and we all had a blast! Ian was a great guide and kept us all entertained! 10/10 experience

I met some warm-hearted people on this experience. Ian and Oriol are very open and fun
People and they have organized a great boat tour. There was delicious bubbly and also some snacks on the sailboat.

A perfect night to watch the sunset over Barcelona. I was able to take some great photos of the city during the sunset. Our captain Ian was great. He provided information about the area and kept us moving at a great pace along the coast. I would highly recommend this experience to others. I also made some great friends and we went out for Sangria after the cruise.
Very nice experience! We are in a small group so it's ideal to enjoy the sailboat! Enough food and drink for everyone!

Do not hesitate to book this experience! It was a beautiful day, with an awesome crew who helped accommodate us with drinks and food. Super friendly group as well. We enjoyed every bit of it. It wasn’t over crowded and you get to enjoy the city skyline and sea. You’ve got to experience it for yourself.

This was the best experience. Guides were friendly and accommodating. If you would like to swim, make sure you ask before departing if your boat will stop for swimming. They only stop for swimming if the majority of the boat wants to swim. If it is not a majority vote, they will not stop for swimming but did hover around in beautiful Insta (Picture) worthy spots. However, they keep the Cava flowing and it is a beautiful trip. Would definitely do again.

I paid 40e for a ticket. The instructor on the day was rude and I felt scolded for rules he didn’t communicate clearly at the beginning of the trip to tourists and not seasoned sailors.

Better providers are available for a more affordable price who will you offer you a better package of a) guided tour b) more friendly to guests and c) value for money

We booked the 4:30pm sail to experience a different view of Barcelona. The team was very good, thoughtful touches, great explanation of the boat and a wonderful way to spend a few hours in the city. We would come visit again and recommend booking with them.

This was SUCH a lovely experience. It was a beautiful way to see the sights and share it with others. Would absolutely recommend this to anyone that loves spending time on the water and is looking for a unique activity.

My friends and I had an EXCELLENT time! Harry was a great captain, amazing sense of humor. Frida was amazing and even gave my friends and i a treat with a candle for me to make a wish! If i return to Barcelona, i will absolutely do this excursion again!!!

Really good experience and service on the boat… Eduardo and our Italian volunteer made sure we felt welcome and well supplied of drinks. It was difficult to get there so allow 30 minutes extra for this. Best instruction: behind the History Museum. We got the sails up!! But too windy for a swim.
The sunset cruise was wonderful! Our host/captain was attentive, very personable, and great to visit with! Overall, I would highly recommend to anyone wanting to get out on the water for a few hours.

Out of this world experience! Not only were they quick to respond to my messages, Eduardo and Rodrigo were fabulous hosts, made sure we were safe but also replenished our snacks and drinks frequently. Great way to start your vacation in Barcelona! HIGHLY recommend it!
This was an amazing experience and highly recommend to anyone wanting to spend some time on the water. Varvara was great! Would definitely go back!

I had an amazing time with Nora for this boat trip! Never been on a boat before, and she was very careful with all the security procedures, and took time to explain us everything
I'll definitely recommend it and keep that in mind for my future trip!
My girlfriend and I enjoyed this experience greatly! She has a sensitive tummy and the captain was very keen on assuring her of safe passage without getting sea sick
Really loved this experience. As someone who travels a lot, it’s a great way to step away from the touristy spots and do something different!

Best sailing experience in Barcelona ever, we had an amazing time with our skipper Noura and the other guy they were very nice, and super friendly, also the other people in the same boat were very nice and friendly, and we loved every moment during the journey.

I have never been sailing and it was wonderful. She said we would be able to swim but didn’t stop, but the water was rough ish so not sure if I would’ve. People and beverages were amazing. The only thing was that the tour was from 2-4pm and we didn’t leave harbor until 2:25pm. But, the value for this was also less expensive than anywhere else I found so still happy.

Although it felt rushed, it was a great experience to see the Mediterranean Sea from Barcelona. I was fortunate enough to get a couple chances to swim in the Mediterranean but it was also rushed as well. Nora the skipper was great and I was also fortunate to have the whole boat with a couple as well. I would highly recommend this experience despite the short time (2 hours goes by so fast!). The cava Nora provided was great too!

Great opportunity for a short sailing trip! It is well organized and communication is great. The crew was friendly and professional. Our glasses were almost never empty ☺️. And if you happen to have a great company of other passengers (like we did), it is just a bonus!
what an incredible experience! The captains were so kind and thoughtful and funny! We had the best time, seriously a highlight of our trip - we couldn't recommend it more

The place was as described and as pictured. Located a few steps from the Sagrada Familia, the views were beautiful. Metro station is right next to the Sagrada familia, nice cafe below the apartment. Like other reviewers have mentioned, the area is very busy during the day, but super quiet at night.
We liked the restaurant La Guinda that was mentioned by another reviewer. It is a 2 minute walk from the apartment, and it is in a very quiet spot.
An amazing trip with Skipper Harry - Great food, great drink and amazing views. Played some good music to set the vibes and connected on a personal level. Just wished it was longer!
It was a positive experience. Hope I could do it again asap. All the best wished to the crew and caption. Thanks Varvara for a beautiful sunset.
The experience was great and very enjoyable the only issue was that we booked for a sunset tour but we were back on land well before the sunset

This was a wonderful experience. The skipper told us stories as we sailed, told us about the boat, but also gave us time to be by ourselves. There was food and drinks that kept coming and we also stopped to take a swim in the sea too (which was amazing!). This was a great value tour that I would recommend to anyone.

I went with my family, I really liked it, managed to swim and beat it. I also enjoyed the snacks and drinks. The only thing is, we didn't immediately find a meeting point, the navigator was confusing. Overall, I recommend, friendly staff, there were only beautiful memories! Thank you
We had such a great time on our trip. Better than all expectations- I couldn’t recommend it more. I’d def book it again.
It's a great experience if you're coming to Barcelona. Eduardo is a genius. You can drink and eat with a free tap and that's super good. The views are amazing

This experience was so much fun! We didn’t have a chance to go in the water because of weather conditions but the hosts were very up front about that and offered us the option of switching to the next day. We had a great time and the boat is awesome!

Amazing experience with beautiful views and great people. Ava was our skipper and she was very attentive and knowledgeable about sailing and Barcelona in general. The sunset over the city was magical and something I’ll never forget. Thank you so much!
The hosts were excellent. Nora and Evelyn were so welcoming and excited to take us on this experience. If I go on another boat trip in Barcelona, it will be with them.

We loved our sailing experience in Barcelona! We went in the afternoon 2-4pm and it was a great way to spend a couple hours, enjoying the water and taking in the views. Our hosts/skippers Nora and Evelyn were wonderful, made us feel comfortable and were accommodating to everyone’s needs. Would highly recommend this experience!
Nora and Evelyn were super nice and very accommodating! We loved every minute of it. The wind made the ride slightly bumpy, but that just added to the fun!

Our experience with this was incredible. Out skippers were fantastic. Super safe, super friendly, super easy to communicate with. We got to know them well and the other people on our trip were fun as well. The drinks and snacks were great and unlimited, they kept coming the entire time. Beautiful views, amazing people. Wish we could do it again every day we are here!
This was a great experience. We felt safe, got a chance to “drive” the boat, and enjoyed ourselves even though the water was too choppy to swim. Our staff was very friendly, too.

Such an awesome experience. We had unlimited Spanish charcuterie and wine. It was raining the day that we went out so we didn't get to swim and we might have taken a different route because of the fact that the conditions for swimming were not ideal. The boat was beautiful and Vicky and Julie were so sweet, funny and helpful. They really improved the experience and we felt really welcomed by them. I wish that it had been sunnier on the day that we went so we could have swam but I am thankful that we still went. I would recommend this!

Vicky and Juli were fantastic and very attentive on our boat trip! The cava glasses were never empty and the snacks were lovely. It felt very personalized and we got some tips for local restaurants to visit afterwards. The communication with Varvara was a bit disappointing as we never got a response to our question the day before.

Harry was a fun, warm and friendly host. The bottomless glass of Cava and tasty Charcuterie plate were delicious and the view on the water was magical. Our family had a wonderful time. This excursion was a highlight of our visit.

Highlight of our Barcelona trip! The staff was very friendly, punctual, and knowledgeable about sailing. Met some great new friends and were offered plenty of cava and snacks. Such pretty views and worth the price for sure!!
this experience is highly recommended for those looking for a relaxing sailing tour. our captain Harry was so much fun to talk to. had a nice time meeting new people.
Great sailing experience but we did not get much time for swimming with the water conditions on the day we took the trip !

I really enjoyed this experience! Varvara is super nice and hospitable. The boat was really cool and it was fun going out onto the front of it. Unfortunately I got seasick because the waves that day were really intense, but Varvara and the captain of the boat were super accommodating and helped me through it. In the end it was a really fun experience and I would do it again!
Great experience on the boat. The captains were lovely. We got through 4/5 bottles of wine/sparkling wine between 8 of us so that was very generous.
Such a lovely experience. Vicky and Fredericka were fantastic hosts. The group was small and we made a new friend, would attend again!

I promise you, you won’t regret booking this experience. As a solo traveller, this was a great way to get out on a beautiful afternoon, meet new people and see a different side of Barcelona! We had a blast sailing, snacking and drinking bottomless wine and cava. Diving into the water to cool off was definitely a highlight! Thank you to our crew onboard the Ava, you were wonderful!
Frederica and Vicky were both very accommodating and kind. The view was spectacular and the swimming was amazing. Great snacks and drinks as well.

This was a really beautiful experience and Evelyn and Nora (not sure about names) were super friendly hosts on the boat, the music and snacks were a really nice touch. It was definitely a highlight of our time in Barcelona.

Some things to note unrelated to our actual “captains” who were wonderful but rather the organizer of this experience:

We were told to show up 15 minutes early and that latecomers would not be accepted. We ended up waiting 20 minutes by the security guard office and the WhatsAp number given to us was not even registered /reachable in the app. One member of our group happened to have a local data plan and eventually was able to reach someone who was not very friendly or helpful. After we got checked in and provided our names we then proceeded to wait another 20 minutes for a latecomer. These delays unfortunately cut into the time you spend on the boat so keep that in mind. They were also frustrating to us in particular because we rushed over to this meeting point, navigating around the busy Catalonian independence day protests for September 11th. Had we known we didn’t need to show up early or even on time it would certainly have saved some blisters and stress on an already hot day!

The pictures in the experience show people jumping in the water - this was not part of our experience, maybe because we had booked a sunset time rather than a midday slot. This should be clarified in the activity description. We also messaged before hand with the organizer about whether to arrive already wearing our bathing suits or if we should change into them on the boat so it’s strange that we weren’t informed ahead of time that we wouldn’t be swimming.
We had so much fun! It was fun to meet people traveling around Barcelona and the hosts were amazing. The views were great and it was so nice to see the views of the city from the water

The sailboat experience was absolutely amazing!! Highly recommend this tour if visiting Barcelona! Varvara was so nice and very welcoming! The only downfall was it not being long enough as it was so much fun!!!!

So AMAZING!! Boat was beautiful and comfortable. Drinks were very good and the tapas was a nice touch for a snack!
The skipper was very friendly, professional and made sure to explain all safety rules.
The skipper assistant was wonderful! She assisted all needs and was a pleasure to talk with.
Going around the bay was beautiful and it was wonderful jumping off the boat into the water.
Very fun and will do it again! Highly recommend.
It was the most amazing experience Ive had! The host was spectacular and thoughtful, the view and the sunset were more than I imagined! I would love to do this again💙

We had a great time on the boat even though the seas were particularly rough that day. The crew made sure that we were comfortable from the minute we got onto the boat. The cava was fantastic as well.
The water was a bit rough but our captain made the experience very enjoyable. He was very knowledgeable about the city and kept the vibe and energy up!
Fantastic sail at sunset. Varvara gave very clear instructions on where to meet and was very professional and personable. We had a great time.
The hosts were so knowledgeable and friendly. We had a great time and our glasses were never empty. Truly took our trip to the next level!

SO BEAUTIFUL! highly recommend!!! Our glasses were always full of prosecco, the sail boat was stunning, an unforgettable experience. Could not stop smiling during the entire ride. Amazing memories were made, i urge everyone to do this !

The weather was a bit of a let down but we still had the loveliest time on the boat! Nora and Lisa were amazing hosts, made us super comfortable and were great story tellers, would definitely do this trip again
5 stars is not enough to describe how good the experience was. You’ll meet great people and the hosts are awesome as well.

Such an awesome experience! Drinks filled up everytime they were empty, snacks to nibble on, could play music and sit out in the sun! The ladies who looked after us on the boat were great, super accomodating to last minute changes and even got us in the water when there was finally a patch of water not too choppy! So grateful, awesome way to end the stay in Barcelona!

As a group of 4 girls, we were expecting a great trip but our expectations were exceeded! The hosts were wonderful and ensured there was not an empty glass and food was consistently refilled! The group on our boat were absolutely lovely and we had a great afternoon. Just be aware that choppy water may result in less swimming more of a quick dive but the hosts were so accommodating and allowed us a great chance to dive in!

This experience was awesome. The team was amazing, the drinks flowed easily and we enjoyed the people who were on the experience as well. Boating in Barcelona is an unbeatable experience, especially with this team. Highly recommend!

Great, the hosts and everything in general
although they should have warned in advance that there would be a chance not to bathe in the sea since many take the tour with expectations of bathing in the sea!!
of the rest, everything is fine

Lovely experience. The sea was rougher than expected but it made the experience more interesting, and there was a good balance of relaxing in the port. Our glasses were always full and we enjoyed the snacks!

I did the 7pm sunset experience. It was nice and our captain and skipper were very friendly. I do recommend people taking motion sickness medicine before going as people who thought they were okay… weren’t. Half our group got sick and it kind of changed the vibes. I think it’s because it’s a smaller boat so you feel the rocking waves much more. Also by the time we got started and the time it took to go back to the port, it felt a bit short. If the tour was more like 3 hours I think it would have been better to settle in and really enjoy the experience. There was unlimited drinks and snacks!
Amazing! Our captain was hilarious & very kind! Also, really recommend doing this at the start of your trip :) you’ll meet other people on the boat and it’s a great experience!

I would highly recommend this experience. The skippers were incredibly hospitable and it really felt like a once in a lifetime opportunity to see Barcelona from another perspective. My only note is to take a Dramamine before the ride if you’re prone to motion sickness.
Very fun experience! It was a great time. It was fun to meet other people and the views were amazing! Our host Eduardo was great! Highly recommend… fun experience!
Really a beautiful experience, the staff is very kind and very prepared, great cava and snacks...shame for the time it didn't allow us to bathe!
Such a perfect activity for your time in Barcelona. I would HIGHLY recommend it! The staff were so nice and the whole experience was so much fun! They had perfect snacks and tons of drinks!

Such an amazing experience, I loved our group and our captain was so kind, thoughtful and told us great stories about the area and seem to really love taking us out on the boat! Absolutely would recommend this to everyone coming to Barcelona. Highlight of our trip!

Harry was a fantastic captain! The water was a bit choppy that day, but he did the absolute best to ensure that everybody was having a good time. My stomach, along with the stomach of another girl in our group, began to feel uneasy because of the waves and he offered us different solutions to help us feel more comfortable. My husband really enjoyed the fact that he got to drive the boat for pretty much the whole voyage and one of the other guests was also involved helping with the hoisting of the sails. Although, the water was rougher than expected and we couldn’t go swimming, it was still a great experience all things considered. If it was this enjoyable with the waters being choppy, I can only imagine how much more enjoyable it would be when the water is more calm.
We had a great time. It was a pity about the weather but other than that, Eduardo was a great host and we had an amazing time!

Highly recommend this experience. Our captain navigated difficult waters well- we weren’t able to swim due to the conditions but it was a great experience. We were on the boat with two other groups and ended up getting drinks together with everyone afterwards. If you easily get sea sick consider taking Dramamine beforehand- all of us were fine!
Fun time sailing Pepe did a fantastic job, if only the weather was little bit better to go swimming besides that great job!👋🏼
We had a lovely time on our sunset trip! Unfortunately the weather was a bit too rough to go swimming but we had a blast drinking and chatting with everyone on board
We had a fantastic time out on the water with Ian who made us all feel at home and was friendly and entertaining, always keeping conversation and drinks flowing. Would absolutely sail with him again!

The weather wasn’t ideal for sailing on the scheduled day, but I still had a great time to meet other people and the captain while the captain was cruising around in the marina. I’d definitely come back again and definitely recommend to other people to do it (just pray for a good weather for sailing!).

It was a lovely experience!
Hosts are very nice, the boat is nice and the trip was very pleasant.
If you want to see Barcelona from the water, this is the place to be.

This experience is a MUST! Ian who was our Captain and host was super friendly and accommodating. Great knowledge of the area and gave us some great recommendations for places to visit and eat. Julio was also on hand to host and was topping up our drinks before we'd even finished them! Me and my partner also got the chance to swim in the ocean a little and we came away feeling super relaxed and happy. THANKYOU!

A great experience to go sailing in Barcelona. You get to meet new people and share stories!
The skipper is really friendly and helps you with personal suggestions to explore Barcelona to the fullest!

Would definitely recommend this experience while you’re in Barcelona! 🤩

Great experience! Unforgettable time! We had privatized the boat for a birthday and were able to put some music on. Our skipper was excellent, she took care of us very well and let us sail.
Recommended!!

Had such a great time sailing. It was such a beautiful experience and got to meet some really great people. As guests, we were treated extremely well, the crew went above and beyond to ensure that we were all having a good time. Highly recommend trying this !

We really enjoyed our late-morning boat excursion with Frederica and Nora. They were very open, sharing their stories, their love of boating, ample drinks and snacks. It was a gorgeous day and we got to swim in the sea. The water was way saltier than we expected! And very warm! The crew genuinely cared about us having a great time and involved our kids as well. There were 6 other passengers on the boat and we had some small chit chat with them. That’s also part of the experience.

Communication once we booked was excellent. However, I had inquired weeks earlier with some questions and again a few days earlier and never heard back. We decided to book nevertheless - and I’m very glad we did. However, the price had gone up in that time and we could have saved quite a bit on the fee if we had received an answer from the booking agent right off the bat.

This was a great value. It rained on the day of our sunset tour, but we ended up going anyways and got to see an amazing sunset! The rain stopped just as we got to our reservation. They provided us with PLENTY of champagne and the views were absolutely incredible. This was such a great deal, I would absolutely recommend. The hosts (Varvara and Pieter) were so fun and easy to chat with. The definitely made the experience amazing.

It was really a nice and fun sailing trip with the captain and his co-sailor despite the stormy weather at the very end. 😊
We would definitely go for the sailing trip again on a sunny day when visit Barcelona next time!

I had a super lovely time at the boat Jack. Even though the weather changed at some point our captain and skipper made the experience unique and much enjoyable. I can recommend the trip for everyone who wants to experience something aside from the land.

Great hosts, perfect way to send a couple hours out in the sun. The water was a little bit choppy that day, but we still had a great time!

Awesome experience

I was worried because I didn't have any Korean reviews, but it was so much fun! It was a real movie time, talking to tourists from various countries, drinking champagne, lying down, and... It was a real movie time.
Peter and Ian were brilliant hosts on the boat, they helped us have such an amazing time! Drinks were flowing and chat between guests made for an enjoyable time! Highly recommend
The tour was amazing. The captain and staff were very nice and provided us light snacks and cava. The sunset and skyline was beautiful. I would consider doing the tour again.
Really wonderful Skipper and crew, amazing views of the city from the sea. We had such a great time. Only wish we could have stayed on the boat all afternoon, but we would definitely do it again.
Don't hesitate to book this experience. The crew were experienced and knowledgeable. It was a great short trip which added to our Barcelona experience. Memories that will last our lifetime for sure.

Everything about the two hour cruise was perfect. Julio and Harry were the perfect hosts and took us to such a great swim spot, always making sure we had everything we needed. It was such a good hen party activity and definitely a highlight of the weekend!

Went on this trip with some friends - we all had a great time sailing around Barcelona. We couldn’t believe how quickly time flew by! We went on the evening trip and the sunset was breathtaking. They were also great on the boat - bery friendly, informative and generous on the Cava! Great experience to do in Barcelona.
We had a great tour with a fun group. Our glasses were never empty and we did the sunset tour and saw some spectacular colors out on the water.

An amazing experience! We started the sail by cruising around the marina and harbor before sailing around the coast of Barcelona. We were constantly provided drinks including soda, water, beer, cava, and white wine along with the traditional Spanish tapas. Varvara was very informative and Julie was a great co-captain. Overall would highly recommend adding to your Barcelona vacation!
This sunset cruise was an amazing experience, definitely a must-do in Barcelona! Our captain, Iván, was incredible and made us feel relaxed and safe :)

A great excursion for the price! Our host was very welcoming and kind, and jumping out to swim in the Mediterranean while looking at the Barcelona skyline was a really amazing experience. I would do this excursion again!
Wonderful experience! The captain was so friendly and welcoming, I loved every minute of this experience! You get amazing drinks, snacks, atmosphere and new friends! Thank you so much!!)

MUST DO IN BARCELONA - cannot explain how incredible this experience is. Regardless of where you come from this sailboat ride was phenomenal. Request Ian as your guide and you will love every moment. A friend and I visited Barcelona for 3 days as part of a Spain backpacking trip and this was the best part of our stay. Met incredible people, had drinks & tapas (meats and cheese) while also jumping into the water. Ian knows how to make everyone feel welcomed and makes great conversation with guests. Book this!!!

Wonderful experience with the most friendly crew! This is perfect for people of all ages and getting to jump in the water was so refreshing. The snacks and cava were incredibly thoughtful. Would definitely recommend and book again!

This experience was incredible! I highly recommend for those who like adventure and relaxing on the water. It was such a perfect day to sail and watch the sun go down. The evening swim felt incredible. The hosts were awesome/super accommodating and I made some great new friends! I highly recommend this experience!

We had a great time out on the sailing boat. Captain Vicky and her skipper were really friendly and helpful, plenty of drinks and snacks going around. We have loads of time to sun bath out on the boat and take a quick swim in the sea, great experience!

great evening out on Ava - fun people to Saul with and a great crew. refreshments were good and the crew was great at making sure our glasses were filled. Fantastic to spend some of the trip sailing without the motor - a rare treat . Highly recommended

What a great experience! Our captain (Harrison) never let our drinks run dry and provided a great evening! Would definitely recommend the 7:30PM sunset tour!

We were able to walk all around the boat and never felt crowded! 10/10 recommend!
Had an incredible time out on the boat!! The the crew was extremely welcoming and nice and made the experience so much better.

Very nice sailing experience. The companions were really nice, we had a choice of swimming around the boat or sailing,
at sunset. Tapas, drinks, swimming, and sunset really made this experience special

AMAZING boat ride! It was my first time sailing and it went incredible. Everyone on the staff is very friendly, as well as the people that came on board with us. We sailed through the docks and beaches of Barcelona; we even got to swim for a few minutes and it felt insane. Tapas and cava were on point. Must try experience if you go to Barcelona.
Nice boat, would have been great with two deckhands instead of just the one. Felt rushed/hectic in our experience but overall nice time.

There was a sudden storm coming our way so our captain had us return inland, but let us stay on the boat eating charcuterie, listening to music and drinking wine. She was very friendly and funny and we had a good experience despite the weather.

we had an amazing evening. when u book this trip make sure to book the evening slot so you'll have a sunset to gaze upon. the boat was great if u wanted u where allowed to shipper it yourself for some time which was quite the experience. Victoria was an amazing host. due to her partner beeing sick she had to both cater us and steer the ship but she did an amazing job at that! Its a great way to meet new People and spend some time with a loved one.

We booked the sailing trip during sunset hour and I can really recommend it. Drinks a snacks were served on the boat and we even had the chance so help steering and sailing the boat. Definitely a recommendation!
Vicky was extremely friendly to us, she took good care of us aboard the boat, only downside we couldn't swim because of the strong wind that day. We don't regret this activity

Our boat trip was great and our host was very accommodating. Whilst we weren't able to swim because of the sea conditions, we still had a fantastic time. There was great views and more than enough refreshments available. Would recommend!

Nora is a great captain, it was fun to be onboard with her and with Vicky. They take security really seriously and want to make sure everyone on board is having fun. The sea was a bit rough but they still made a short break for us to swim. The drinks and snacks offered were nice and did not feel cheap. My family loved it!!!
We had an amazing experience ! Beautiful weather, lovely buffet and great hosts. We were able to move around on the boat and swim in the sea. Very good value for money and would definitely recommend.
great experience, we were able to stay in the front of the boat and swim a little. Victoria and Nora were super nice to us, lots of drinks and a little tray of charcuterie and chips (:
Everyone on the boat was super attentive and welcoming. They always made us feel safe and made sure they met our needs. I definitely recommend to anyone! It was such a cool experience!

This sailing experience was my first and I would definitely do again. Everyone was so kind and there were drinks and light snacks. My cousin and I enjoyed jumping in the Mediterranean Sea. 10/10 would recommend.

we had a lovely time and it was very professional due to the weather and storm coming. they chose safety first and we still went sailing and just went around in the Harbour. had a lovely time chatting and drinking cava and earing some snacks. they gave us the option to rebook or go ahead for a little sail . we felt very safe and we glad they chose not to go out into open water due to the storm coming. I would definitely do it again! and they were just a wonderful crew !
It was such a treat to get out of the city and out on the water. I love to sail, and it was a beautiful experience to see Barcelona from this perspective.

This is a splendid experience, but you have to consider that no matter what, the sea has the final say. It would have been fun to swim, but the water was too choppy and we ended up needing to turn around. It was still lovely to meet people and enjoy a quick sail

Excellent experience.
The skippers that guided us on the trip were very friendly and available to answer any questions or curiosities.

The boat trip was really great! The skippers were super nice and accommodating. Due to a thunderstorm, our tour only had to be cancelled, but we were offered to stay directly for snacks and either cancel and get the money back or join a tour the next day. So really very guest-friendly and good service! The atmosphere on the boat was overall great (the next day without thunderstorm :D) Glad to come back!
Fun sailing trip! Best to go at sunset and see the beautiful view. The boat is rather small so you may get seasick

What a fantastic experience! The boat was very nice and the views were great. I recommend the sunset option. The captain was super friendly and knowledgeable (about sailing and Barcelona), and did a great job keeping the trip fun. We also had a great group of people on board from all over the place, talk to your other members! Give yourself ample time to find the meet up, but I found the instructions provided were accurate and easy to follow.
this was a pleasant and affordable way to get out on the water with our friends, have a view of Barcelona and enjoy a swim in the mediterranean. the crew was lovely and it was a very nice excursion.

A great boat ride in the Mediterranean off the coast of Barcelona. We had the city in our sights the whole time, and the view was incredible. The skipper was super friendly and accommodated the group's wish to make a stop for a quick swim (the water was amazing because the weather was very hot that day). Overall, a fun experience, and I recommend it!

Amazing experience and activity for a sunny day in BCN! Our crew was very friendly and welcoming and we had a blast swimming in the ocean and watching Barcelona’s skyline. It's a must-do when in town 10/10
Even though it was windy, we had a beautiful time. Crew is one of a kind, super genuine & fun, thanks both for making it such a great (&safe!) sail :) until next time!
Despite a good skipper, unfortunately the weather was a little finicky and the ocean sailing experience turned into a harbor tour.
The weather did not permit us out of the harbor. The guide was wonderful and made the best of the situation. Just know before you book that this can happen and it changes the experience.

There were 4 of us, and we were with four other people. We had a great time, unfortunately the sea was shaking and we couldn't jump in. But the girls were very friendly and speak good languages. We felt well cared for, everything was well explained
A great experience with a really knowledgeable sailor. She provided history and information about the areas we passed by and was very attentive to all guests.
Great time! We didn’t have much luck with wind but the Eduardo and Uriol were super hosts and there was plenty of cava and good pictures taken!

It was a nice experience but the time passes really quick , and if you want to have more fun rent a boat that plays music more loud and party music , if you are just with family then is good for you cuz is more chill

Sailing cruise on the sea with snacks, drinks and music. What’s not to like? Everything went smoothly on our trip. Communication was clear and we felt well taken care of. I was a bit disappointed that there wasn’t enough wind our our trip to actually sail, and the sea was too wavy to stop for a dip on the water. However, you can’t control the weather. The day was sunny and the view of the city was spectacular. Also, even though we were motoring, the motor on the sailboat was one of the quietest I’ve ever heard. I barely noticed it.

Amazing experience. We sailed out of the port for about 20 minutes and then went for a really nice swim. Had a few beers and a couple glasses of wine and then came back to the port after some more sailing. Highly recommend.
It was fine. Good not great. You get what you pay for. A bit disorganized and started late. Everyone was friendly though! We had a good time but there are too many great things to do in Barcelona
Our skipper was great, the sailboat was beautiful but the ocean was a bit choppy & felt a wee bit scary. But I understand weather is definitely out of their control
Definitely must do when in Barca! Because of the wind we couldn’t swim, but it was still a very nice experience. Eduardo and his crew were great and made it a fun day out on the water!

We had a lovely time with the skipper Victoria. We were able to sail on the beautiful Jack sailboat from Barcelona's Vell harbor. The boat is new, the atmosphere on the boat is great! Vicky made us feel super welcome and shared her passion with us by sailing. A big thank you to her. I recommend this experience during your stay in Barcelona!

It was a very nice experience. Our skipper is very nice and thoughtful person. Our trip was a solid 2 hours trip, by which we enjoyed nice drinks and snacks, as well as swimming in the middle of the sea. I would recommend this trip!

Amazing experience! Well thought of and was fun from start to finish! Would definitely do it again, was comfortable and relaxed vibes plenty of drinks and snacks on the boat which added to the experience.

We had an amazing time with our skipper Ian! I never expected the 2 hours to be so personal and welcoming. Ian made sure that everyone was feeling comfortable at all times and was a great host. I can recommend going on the trip as you will have an unforgettable experience! Thank you Ian!
A tour with views of the coast of Barcelona. Our skipper Eduardo was very welcoming. Unlimited beverage but charcuterie trays a little light for 10 people
Amazing trip! Going out to sea to see Barcelona in the afternoon heat was amazing. Our hosts were so fun and thoughtful. Recommending to a friend who’s visiting in 2 weeks!

Great crew and experience. Fede and Alberto were knowledgeable, fun to talk to and made us feel like we were amongst friends. The cava was a plus. This experience is a must during your trip to Barcelona.
Amazing trip, very funny staff and also extremely helpful and considerate. Definitely must go if you want to have some good vibes and cava meanwhile checking over Barceloneta beach from sea.

We booked this trip as a group of 5 and the girl that was housing us was Liz. She was amazing, very precautios and very fun. We enjoyed this trip at sunset with a lot of cava. Best experience that you can do in Barcelona.

Amazing experience, especially for that price. We had a beautiful 2 hours of sailing, tapas and cava. Our skipper Liz was very kind and professional. Don’t miss it if you come to Barcelona! Definitely much better and personal than cruises with 30-50 people on board.
The trip was only 1.5 hours and most of that time was spent getting into and out of the harbor. Guides, music and boat were very nice.

We had such a blast in this experience! The location was very easy to find, the excursion was stunning, and the captain Liz and her partner were the best. We thought Liz was especially wonderful and she made the trip so much fun. Would absolutely recommend to anyone.
2 hours flew by so quick bc how great the experience was! Varvara is very friendly and accommodating and I felt safe being in the boat as she is quite an expert.

The captain and her assistance were super nice. And lots of food and drinks were provided. However, it was not possible to swim in the sea as the weather condition is not ideal. Overall good experience.

We had an excellent time with Lis, she was super friendly and knowledgeable and we felt safe the whole time. She had a great sense of humor, told us more about the area, and also had a fun boat playlist. The views were amazing, and I loved seeing all the jellyfish! Sitting at the front of the boat was my favorite part.

We enjoyed the experience! Nice host, nice and engaging captain, pleasant guests. Unlimited/good drink options. Snacks were fine - but would have been nice if they were a bit more substantive and plentiful. As for the sailing - we loved the ride, but would loved it even more if we could have sailed a bit more, and used the motor a bit less (and if the 2-hour trip could have been offered as a 3-hour trip, as we finished, wishing for a bit more). Overall - good trip out on the water!

We had a great time on the boat! The captain and her assistant were so nice and accommodating. Unfortunately, due to water conditions we couldn't swim, but we still had a great time! I would do it again in a heartbeat!
We had a great time on the boat! The staff is really friendly. Liz, the captain, always made sure we were all confortable. Do it it’s fun!
There’s not a mor perfect way to watch a Barcelona sunset. The colors are hypnotic and the cruise around exceeds expectations with relaxing music and a fun atmosphere!
My friends and I had a great time with Vicki. She was super sweet and very helpful. We met new friends and would definitely do this trip again.
Great experience, Vicky and Peter were super attentive at all times and helped us make the experience great since we were bachelorette party. We had a great time and I definitely recommend it.

It was such a great experience, everyone visiting Barcelona should do it. The boat was really nice, the drinks were delicious and Varvara was the perfect host.
Thank you so much!
Great experience! Had a really fun time with my family. Even my 6 and 4 year old enjoyed sailing. Really enjoyed the captain, she was very entertaining and funny! Highly recommend!
We did the sailing trip to the sunset and it was just beautiful. Our skipper was Lies and she couldn't have made it better. Gladly come back.
Great experience, lovely breeze as the boat is moving and view of the city and beaches! lovely thing to do especially on a hot day

The sailing excursion was a beautiful way to spend time in Barcelona. Our group got to go on a gorgeous day and even though our captain thought originally that we would not be about to get into the water, we were able to stop and swim around for 20 minutes. Great value and experience all around!
The people we're incredibly friendly and the sunset sailing was so beautiful. The yacht is gorgeous. I recommend eceryone who goes to Barcelona to do this on their trip! Greetings Eva & Jan :)
My friends and I had a lovely time: the atmosphere aboard the boat was very good, Vicky is attentive, and the walk is very nice. I would recommend it without hesitation!
I had fun!!! We had some technical issues but on the bright side, I get to stay on the boat a little bit longer.

The skipper Vicky and his team Thijs etaiensympathetic and professional.
Swimming in the open sea is to be discovered (weather permitting).
A small downside: The experience description is misrepresented It is described as a couple sharing a sailing with guests on their personal boat when it is actually a fleet of boats with employee skippers. Much less poetic. So the listing is misleading.

Nice experience (boat reserved for a group of 10.
The skipper Vicky and his team Thijs were super friendly and very professional.
Swimming in the open water was a unique experience.
The only small downside is that it's a fleet of boats with employee skippers. Not a couple of owners take you on their boat to share their passion for sailing. The listing is therefore misleading on this point. However, I would recommend it for the experience.

We had an incredible experience on a beautiful boat! Vicky, our skipper, was incredible. So knowledgeable and helpful. She went above and beyond to give us a great experience (took our pictures, made sure our drinks were always filled, let us try things with the boat!)! It was definitely a highlight of our trip!

We had a lovely experience on the sunset cruise. Our captain ‘Vicky’ was extremely personable and professional. She handled the sailboat perfectly! It was perfect sailing conditions - the sea was calm and we had a spectacular sunset view. Definitely was a wonderful way to end our European trip!

Our sail guide Vicky was AMAZING! So informative & kind and made sure our safety was prority. We had a sunset sail with very calm water and were able to swim off the back of the boat. Was definitely my favorite vacation moment & I’d recommend to anyone 10/10!
We had a lovely time on our sunset sail - drinks, snacks and a great swim. A special thanks to Vicky our skipper who made sure we had the best time.

During our stay in Barcelona we took part in this sailing tour with my friend.

Very soothing. A little snack at the beginning, we leave the port to go to the sea where we swim. Swimming time, though, could be longer. We only swimmed 5-7 minutes.

Otherwise it was great!

This was the most fun adventure my family and I did on our vacation! We all had such a great time, I only wish we could stay out on the water longer. Will definitely try to do it again if I’m ever back in Barcelona, and I highly recommend for others to try it out as well. The crew was so incredibly kind and personable, they made it so fun!
The best experience we had in Barcelona. Great value. Invited for snacks and drinks. Highly recommended!
this was a great sailing trip! gorgeous, we got to swim, great group of people and an amazing deal for a boat trip with unlimited drinks.

This experience was a highlight of our trip. Our captain Aileen (might be mispelling that) was amazing. Getting on and off the boat was easy. The boat ride itself was relaxing, fun and gorgeous. Highly recommend!
We had a great sailing trip at sunset. It was magical! We met very nice people and were enjoyed excellently. ♡ Thank you!!

We had an incredible time sailing with Liz! She was a really fun host and we had an amazing time! There was lots to drink and eat and we could choose our own tunes. We were honoured to watch Liz do her first rescue mission on another boat in the marina and she handled it like a Pro!

The only downside was it went by too quickly. But for the value it was well worth the money! Hoping to do a half day sail sometime soon so we get longer on the water. Highly recommend !

We had the most wonderful time on this experience! Liz was an absolutely amazing captain, so funny and kind and she made us feel comfortable. Swimming in the ocean and seeing the skyline from the sea was MAGICAL. It was my first time booking an Airbnb experience and I will definitely be doing it more in the future.
Must do during a stay in Barcelona to enjoy the beautiful weather and views with a drink! The experience is all the better with friendly and passionate hosts! Recommended!
Great time!! The weather was bad but our experience was great! We ended up sailing in the harbor drinking wine and having some good cheese. The sailors were great and funny!!
We really enjoyed our boat trip, even one of my family who doesn't like boats! Liza was a great host; very knowledgeable and friendly. We would definitely recommend.

lovely 2h trip in bay - Ian was our skipper, he was very friendly and professional! HE took very good care of one of our group who sometimes feels sea sick. snacks provided are very light so make sure you do dinner before or after :)

I would definitely recommend taking this opportunity if you have the time in your schedule! It was so cool to be out on the water and open up the sails. We were able to see the whole coastline, and even had the chance to jump in for a quick swim! The waters were a little choppy, but other than that it was a great first time experience on a sail boat.

Had a very nice boattrip with a friendly captain and crewmember. We had the pleasure of meeting some nice other people on the boat as well, which only added to the experience. I can only recommend it!

We were greeted with a wonderful welcome and immediately offered drinks on the boat. The guide and skipper were really friendly and knowledgable, and the snacks were delicious. Being out on the sea with the wind and sun is so calming, especially on a really hot day. Definitely something to do when you're in Barcelona.
This was truly the best Airbnb experience I’ve done! Such amazing hosts, such a great experience. So fun and everything was well thought out. HIGHLY recommend.

We had a lovely time on our cruise. Our two guides were friendly and outgoing, and they made the experience great. For the price, I think this is an excellent experience. The maximum people on the tour is 10, so it is a relatively small group. Definitely recommend this tour!
Very service minded and informative hosts! Unfortunately, due to windy weather, We didn’t get to sit at the front of the boat or swim.
We really enjoyed our experience at the boat. The sail was so peaceful, relaxing and enjoyable and the stories of how everything started were just inspiring. We definitely recommend it!🌊
This was a great experience. It was nice getting on the water and giving our feet a break from walking the city all day. Friendly and professional staff

The experience was wonderful. Our skipper was kind and accommodating. She took us out to see the bluest waters and shared fun facts along the way. This experience is great for anyone include families with babies!
The trip was overall a good experience and the host was great with a lot of knowledge and expertise. Unfortunately the sea was too rough to go swimming.

Liz was a very friendly and knowledgeable skipper.
The sailboat ride was a little lacking in variety:an edge going through, an edge back through. a little variety in sailing would have been welcome.
No possibility of diving into the water given the wind. (circumstances independent of the organizers).
A small downside also since it is not a boat ride with its owners, as explained in the description but also employees who sail a rental boat.

This was a lovely way to spend a Sunday afternoon in Barcelona! They met us at the port security gate and then we got on the boat for the sailing, drinks, and snacks. The crew was super friendly. Great experience even though it was too windy to swim. Highly recommend!!

This was incredible. The hosts were great! They were kind, very clearly explained how to be safe on the boat and were very accommodating. The water today was rocky and they gave people an option if they were prone to sea sickness. Would highly suggest!

Great experience, Liz was a great host and captain!🚤
she shared the instructions to enjoy the experience and be safe the entire time, and she kept an eye on everyone the entire time to ensure we had a good time! Súper recommended!

Such an amazing experience and something I will definitely try again if I come back to Barcelona! Crew was friendly, cava was delicious and the view of the sunset was beautiful and totally worth seeing by sea. Great value for the experience we had. Would definitely recommend!

Our sail with Liz and Sima was one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona! Though the water was too choppy for a swim, watching the sunset and conversing with other travelers was an experience to remember. The crew was friendly, knowledgeable and funny. Cava and snacks were a great touch. Totally worth booking this trip!

Liz was a fantastic captain of our sailboat.

There was an incident in the marina earlier in the day. 2-3 police boats and buoy marking the area. This along with a large ferry boat that was coming into the port cut into our sail time of what was suppose to be 2 hours by 30 minutes. I wish that time would have been made up on the back end of our private tour. I sent a text at least 3 days before our sail to our host asking for non pork products. I guess that the word did not get down to Captain Liz.

Liz has a great story. Her English was pretty good and was very attentive to her guests. We really enjoyed our private tour for 4 people.

We would do it again!
Lies and Tom were excellent captain and crew. Very personable and made the trip very enjoyable! Wish we had booked a longer one!

Our sailing experience with Liz and Tom was fabulous. They kept the drinks and snacks flowing, let our kids help steer and raise the sails, answered our thousand questions, and kept us feeling very safe. Wish we had booked a longer sailing experience!

My best friend and I had a most wonderful time on the sunset ride. We enjoyed having a smaller group, and felt that the captains really tried to get to know all of us on board. The snacks and drinks were nice, and the sunset was beautiful! I’d recommend this to anyone group looking for a nice way to wind down after a long day walking around Barcelona. Even if you are unable to jump in the water for a swim, the sights are absolutely worth it.

It was a wonderful experience! The sailing felt super safe and we were able to go on the front and sides. There was plenty of snacks and drinks to go around. The two staff members were friendly and knowledgeable. A highlight of my trip to Barcelona!
Liz and Tom really made the afternoon special by being informative and fun! We were comfortable the whole time and really enjoyed the great scenery and sailing experience

Very nice experience, and to get to see Barcelona from the seaside. The hosts Liz and Tom was pleasant and thorough with the explanation and storytelling.

Because of bad weather we could not bath :( but all in all it was a pleasant experience.

So amazing experience, was with friends and family, everyone thought it was so cozy and we also had a great captain (Victoria is her name, highly recommend her).
A simply wonderful experience.

Liz and Sima were amazing. We had the perfect afternoon sailing and swimming! Both liz and sima were super tentative and great hosts. Everyone else on the trip were super nice too. Couldn’t recommend the trip enough!

The ride was fantastic and a great length of time, not too long nor not too short. The host (I believe she said her name was Eileen, Ailene maybe?) was brilliant and very personable, talking to guests and being friendly. One guest was unfortunately seasick and the host couldn't have been nicer, dealing with the situation very kindly and discreetly so the majority of the other guests weren't alerted to it. The experience was very pleasant (even for the person who was unwell) and we will definitely do it again should we return to Barcelona. Worth every penny.
This was a wonderful sailing experience! Victoria was an excellent host and the water was beautiful. We even made a few friends! I highly recommend for any couple or family visiting Barcelona!

Liz, Sima & Tom were an incredible crew. We were so lucky to have the 3 of them. The boat was amazing, the weather was perfect, the drinks were flowing and we couldn’t have been happier. Jumping into the middle of the Balearic Sea was the best feeling we’ve had on our entire trip. I couldn’t recommend this experience more. We only had 2 days here and this was the best thing we’ve done. Thanks again!
P.s. great tunes :)
Xoxo
Los Angeles & London gals

You should NOT pass up on this trip! It was amazing. I loved our crew, Liz, Sima & Tom. They were so easy goind and made sure we had a lot of fun while also making sure we were all safe on the sail. It was totally worth the value as well! Plenty of drinks and snacks. If in town definitely book this trip, you won't regret it. I can't wait to go back myself!
Great experience!! I recommend we sailed with Aline very very kind who allowed us to make this experience even better

Wonderful experience! Highly recommend the sunset time for a romantic evening, but with how hot it is during the summer I’m sure going during the day for a longer swim would be amazing. The cava and apps served were lovely and our captain was amazing!
We had a great cruise with Liz as our Captain. Really enjoyed the laid-back vibe and the views of Barcelona from the sea. Highly recommended!
Had a lot of fun but unfortunately couldnt swim cause of wind and bug waves. Also for people who dont boat often dont eat/drink much before to prevent sea sickness.

Amazing tour. Water was too rough to swim at sunset but it was a beautiful sail and well worth the price! Knowledgeable, friendly host and very clear meeting point instructions! My eleven year old son was embarrassed to help steer at the time he was asked, but afterwards was excited that he got to have that experience. Made our time especially memorable. And neither of us get seasick but we happened to take Dramamine just in case, after hearing the seas might be rough, and maybe that saved us! Either way, we were very pleased with the experience! Thank you!
Our trip was amazing! Liz was a great and fun captain. It was nice to see Barcelona from the sea and have some cava and tapas at the same time.

Great sailing experience, even if the weather conditions weren't the best due to no wind.
There were cold drinks and some snacks on board, and the view was beautiful!
We really appreciated it.
A valuable experience. There was no wind to enjoy sailing but the hosts are not responsible for that. Both hours are enough to enjoy. Friendly and helpful captain. Recommended.

we were able to have a great sailing. Careful: family photo, drinks at will. We were also able to swim despite a slightly boisterous water.
activity loved by all
We had a wonderful evening on the water! Both hosts were awesome. Laid back but they also know what they’re doing and how best to keep everyone safe.

Our experience was AMAZING! We were 6 friends for one bachelorette party and had a spectacular time. Tom and Vicky were a 10 host, they made us feel very comfortable and at ease. We will definitely be back, we recommend it with our eyes closed!!
We had a great time on this boat excursion! They always kept the cava flowing and the beers coming. We enjoyed getting to stop and swim for a bit too! Wish it could have been longer!

Nothing better than stepping in to the clear waters off the coast of Barcelona. The sunset is beautiful and the hosts made us feel included and very comfortable. They had a lot of knowledge about the city too which was a superb benefit.

We went on the sailing trip in the evening for catching the sunset🌞 our guides have been Tom and a very friendly and chilled women, unfortunately I forgot her name :( - both were so kind, welcoming and very chilled to talk to. The weather was perfect and we also went for a swim in the sea :) there were free drinks and some snacks :) all in all a fantastic experience! Would definitely recommend 😍 thanks again to Tom and his colleague!☺️
This was an amazing experience. I would recommend this to anyone. I had so much fun. I got to meet amazing people, swim in the ocean for my first time. I would definitely do it again.

Such an insane value for the experience. There were about 8-10 people on the boat and some of us ended up getting drinks afterwards! Met some really great people and it was truly a beautiful sailing experience.

Talk about exceeding expectations! This little boat cruise had to be the cherry on top of my already great day! Lost track of time so can’t say for sure how long we were out there but the boat itself was clean and comfortable. Drinks and snacks provided (soft drinks too!) So you can feel a little luxurious. The view of the city was spectacular from out in the water. Speaking of being “out in the water” bring a swim suit so you can take a dip in the mediterranean! The water was perfect and so clear! No need for a towel as you can quickly (and comfortably) air dry on the ride back to the doc. Would super recommend this activity as I felt it was well worth it!

My friends and I had so much fun! This is the perfect experience if you’re looking for some relaxing time on the water away from the crowds. Barbara and Tom were so nice, giving us all snacks and constantly refilling our glasses. Definitely recommend and would go again!

Had an amazing time on the boat, along with my friends and our host Victoria! She went above and beyond for us, and we enjoyed ourselves alot. We liked it so much that we could easily have spent more time on the boat if we could. We were serves both food and drinks, along with good conversations with Victoria. I highly recommend this☺️

My friend and I absolutely loved this experience! We met so many cool people from all over the world and the hosts were kind and responsible. We both felt very safe and the drinks and snacks were the cherry on top. My favorite part was swimming off the boat - highly recommend!
It was something I wouldn't book so quickly, but it was such a special experience. This has become one of the most beautiful memories of the holiday.

I had a great time! Vicki is such a great skipper and a lovely person in general. She made sure we have the drinks we want, cautioned us of the hard railing around the deck in case we hit our toes.

I do recommend it! Just remember to bring ur own towels~
Loved this Airbnb experience and our captain was well knowledgeable and easy going! Made sure everyone felt comfortable and enjoyed their time out on the water. ☺️
It was great. I loved it. We took a tour in the boat and then we stopped and jumped into the water. It was so good. I loved it.

This was a really great experience! They taught my nephew a little bit on how to sail and even let him drive the boat. I even conquered a bit of my fear and swam in the ocean. They provided snacks and drinks, which was very nice. We enjoyed talkingto them and learning more about their background in sailing and becoming captains.

The sailing trip was very nice and relaxed. Captain and skipper both took great care of all the guests and answered all the questions I had for sailing in detail:-) The tips for visiting Barcelona were also great.

We booked this experience as a double date with our friends and we absolutely loved it! The host was absolutely lovely and friendly. Loved having the drinks and snacks on board. The views were spectacular and getting to swim in the water was so refreshing in the heat. PS make sure to bring towels!
Eduardo was a wonderful skipper. He had a great bubbly personality who made the experience next level. I would recommend going on the sunset cruise. It was amazing.

So much fun! Small groups of around 8 people. Endless cava and beer. Wind was perfect so we were able to take a swim for a bit in the ocean. Crew was very kind and accommodating. Bathroom on board if you need it. Would return for a sunset trip!

This was an amazing experience. Both Tom and alekander were friendly and made the trip great. The views of Barcelona are unreal from the boat. The entire trip was fantastic and I would recommend to anyone.
It was a lot of fun, make sure to talk to the people you’re with. the captains. And take lots of photos for a great experience!

We had a wonderful time! The whole experience was comfortable and beautiful! Our hosts made sure our glasses were never empty and that we were having a lovely time. So nice to see Barcelona from this perspective. Plus being out on the sea was so peaceful. Truly a must when you are in Barcelona!

It was one of the best experiences I ever had, it was a gift for my best friend and she loved it as much as I hoped. It was very special because we sailed at sunset and we could even swim in the sea because it was very calm. The view of Barcelona from the sea is something I will not forget. The captain of the boat was very friendly and made us all fell very comfortable and safe on the boat.
