They gave us drinks and food on our way to the open sea and continued to ask us if we wanted more. I really loved this experience and I will definitely do it again the next time I will come to Barcelona!

Very nice and friendly atmosphere with new people with whom it was a pleasure to share such an amazing memory. Thanks Viki for guiding us during the trip and thanks for letting us swim in the open sea. The wether was amazing!
It is definitely an unforgettable experience with a very friendly crew and lots of wine. The perfect way to spend time with your friends while in Barcelona!
AmaZing experience, the crew is excellent and they do a great job communications all safety measures as well as what’s to be expected on the trip. Would definitely do this sail again!
Any day spent on a boat is a good day. I definitely recommend this if you’re looking for chill vibes, continuous drinks, and new people to talk to!

Amazing experience! We enjoyed every minute and swam in the ocean! the staff (Varvara and Tom) were super nice and friendly! Always offering drinks and snacks were good. 100% recommended if you want something chill also because it’s a small group :)
Granted we were late for the excursions but the host poor communication skills made it very hard to reschedule after he himself promised

Beautiful experience aboard the sailboat, in an idyllic setting with a skipper taking care of everything. We were even able to take the boat's controls and hoist the sails, which was a real pleasure! I highly recommend this timeless moment!

We booked for private tour and we’re in total 7 girls for a bachelorette party. It was a perfect way to finish our hectic day with sailing and relaxing. They provided us with Cava and snacks as much as we liked. I would recommend to everyone, it’s worth the money and I would go again!

Tom and Eduardo were our Skipper and Crew - they were the best!!! We ended up making friends with some other guests too and hanging out for the rest of the time in Barcelona. The yacht was beautiful, the views were exceptional. Must go must go!!
we had such a fantastic time - thank you so much for being accommodating when my friend got sea sick (which was totally unavoidable!!!) highly recommend this experience.
Tom and the other crew were very considerate and take very good care of seasick passengers (me and others). The experience in general was very good and worth the money.

This was an amazing outing for our group of four friends. The experience was just as described, and the hosts were very hospitable. We weren’t able to swim because the sea was too choppy on the day (obviously that’s just how it has to be for everyone’s safety!).
Much better than we thought it would be. Drinks and snacks went great along the smooth sailing. Large boat with room to get comfortable. Would recommend for anyone visiting Barcelona.

The boat trip was a wonderful experience. The hosts were welcoming and talkative, settling us in very easily.
The sight of Barcelona from the sea on this sunny and calm day was beautiful.
Me and my friends all agreed that this experience was a highlight of our time in Barcelona.

Port security is very rude. We arrived at the time provided by host but they weren’t their to meet us. Security approached us, told us to leave, and not to come back until our departure time.

We contacted the host but they never responded.

We returned at our departure time and a different person was waiting to collect us - they also had the nerve to ask why we were late.

I don’t think we ever met the actual “host”.

Boat ride was fine. The reprieve was that another group didn’t show, so we had more space on the boat. I’m not sure the experience would have been as pleasant with 10 people aboard. There were 5 of us and that felt like just right.

I know port security isn’t associated with the host, but if we’re told to meet at a certain point 15 minutes before departure, you’d think the host would be there at least 20 minutes before departure.

It was a great experience overall. I just think that the duration of the sail should be a bit longer as per price, 2 hrs pass by in no time. Other than that everything was awesome. Liz, the captain of the boat is an amazing and knowledgeable person. She made feel everyone welcome.
Liz was a wonderful captain. I was afraid of bad weather but we were lucky to avoid the rain. The skyline was just amazing. Highly recommended. I went there by myself but ended up making new friends.
Liz was a fantastic captain! The weather was very iffy so we didn’t swim, but had a great time chatting, enjoying the sunset and learning about sailing. Would highly recommend to anyone considering.

Relaxing, beautiful boat trip, approximately as described. It's worth noting that we didn't use the main sail, only the smaller one and for some time we went by motor. That depends on the conditions of the wind.
Unfortunately we can go to swim that day because of the bad weather. But it is still a very good experience sailing with Liz. It would be perfect if the weather is nice

nice boat. our captain was wonderful and without crew! i hesitate to complain because with covid it may be difficult here, too, to find people to work. with crew she may have been able to set sail. as it was we motored; i expected to sail. yes, nature is part of it but there was some wind and other boats set sail.
It was a good first time experience of sailing. We were eagerly waiting for some swimming/diving time in the sea but the climate that day was not good. This was informed by our captain.
Our skipper was so incredible, she gave us a great tour of the marina and she even allowed to me practice my Spanish with her. 10 out of 10 would do it again!

Great experience overall. Got the opportunity to meet cool people. The crew were super friendly. Food, drinks were plenty!! Also got the opportunity to observe some dolphins.
Liz (the capitán) is very knowledgeable about the area we were cruising. And Tom (assist)were making sure we always have something to drink.

We got a amazing experience and met people from literally all over the world. The boat crew was super friendly and it’s great that it’s an open bar we got five beers and the girls three glasses of cava but it could have been more if wished. We got unlucky with he weather so we had to go back to port early but it was the only rainy day of our week in barcelona so that’s just unlucky. Great atmosphere. We got to meet columbian people, american people, all extremely friendly. It was super interesting to talk to them about how our countries were different. I highly recommend

This experience was amazing! The host provided very clear instructions on where we would meet and it was a breeze. The captain and the helper on board were great! They truly made us feel like part of the family. Once we set sail, it was all smiles and laughs along the way! Refreshments were provided along the way with plenty (and I mean plenty) of refills! I HIGHLY recommend this tour to anybody who wants to see Barcelona from the Mediterranean.

This was the highlight of our Barcelona trip! We booked a private boat tour with four girls as a gift for one of our friends. We were greeted with snacks and champagne and our captain Aline was amazing! We would definitely all do it again, thanks again for Aline for the experience :)

Such a great experience sailing the Mediterranean! The only thing I would say is I wish it could have been longer! But with that said, you get so much packed in within the two hours... learning how to sail, food and drinks, and swimming. If you are on the fence of doing this tour I highly recommend doing it!

Had a great time with such a friendly host! I felt comfortable enough to get up and explore the boat. I also loved how there was a shady area to get out of the sun if wanted/needed. Would have loved for it to be a little longer but overall it was nice and relaxing.

I thought two hours wasn’t going to be enough time but it was completely sufficient. We got to learn how the parts of the sailboat work and help out when able, swim in the sea, and enjoy drinks and snacks with new friends. Our guide transitioned from Spanish to English easily
And made us all feel very comfortable.

It was an awesome experience to go for sailing and get the view of the city from the sea. Our parents enjoyed a lot. Hospitality was great. Cava also tasted great ;). The crew was very friendly and also took good care of our safety

We had a wonderful time on our cruise. Vicki and Peter were an excellent crew - they were kind, attentive, and did a great job making sure everything went smoothly and safely. We really enjoyed talking with them. We will definitely return on our next trip to Barcelona!
Super great value for price and a great experience of cruising by the coast of Barcelona and enjoying the warm sea with refreshing drinks and enjoyable snacks on the side.

Energetic and fun crew, knowledgeable and offered exceptional service. Enough drinks and snacks. The sun was out, company was great and the swim in the med refreshing and truly a Once in a lifetime experience- hope we can go again one day

very happy with this experience
you can get to know other people on the experience which was great since I was travelling alone

Amazing hosts

The private group sail was worth every penny. we had a wonderful time. The captain was great. The cava was good.

Simple. Fun. Memorable.
Cruise was just the perfect length of time and sunset was amazing. We had great clear weather, calm sea so it was delightful. Enjoyed some cava and met some really nice people!!! Highly recommend
Eduardo was a fun and capable captain. What a delightful way to end a hot summer day in Barcelona — jumping in the Mediterranean, sipping cava, listening to great music. A fantastic value!
Both our captain and crew were extremely kind and easy to talk to. They made the trip fun for everyone on board and were willing to personalize based on passengers preferences.

This excursion was good. Be warned that it is, of course, weather-permitting and if it is too choppy, then you are unable to swim and the trip could get cut short (as it is nauseating). However, that is just the risk you take on the water. Overall, it offered a great view of Barcelona with an accommodating crew.
We would recommend this to anyone looking to relax and have a drink with a beautiful view of the Mediterranean & the city from afar.

Great trip with a really nice captein called Liz! She manage to make everyone feel welcome and enjoy our self. My son ( 9 y) loved talking with here and listening to stories. We had a really nice trip.

Amazing experience enjoying the sunset on the sea! The skipper was really friendly and attentive. The cruise was relaxing and we were able to jump into the sea from the boat which was great.
It is definitely worth the money and I highly recommend it when you visit Barcelona.

Excellent value for money!
Very good cruise with plenty of drinks included.
The skipper was very welcoming and attentive. We had a lovely , relaxing time during our sunset cruise. We even were allowed to jump in the water for the sunset swim. Loved every moment and will do it again in a heartbeat!

This is a great boating experience! Liz was fun and very knowledgable about what she was doing. She prioritized safety so we always felt comfortable when on the boat and swimming off the boat.

The meeting place was a bit hard to find - (Hidden by Airbnb) Maps will take you close to it but not directly to the point. Make sure you look at the directions closely for the restaurant nearby to help.

We only had about 15 minutes to swim and you had to hold a rope off the boat because of the current, just as a heads up. Based on the description I expected bottomless drinks and food (cause it said open bar) but we were offered drinks before we set sail and never again so we only had one. The boat is super nice and clean and the ride is a good length. It was fun to meet people from other places, too. I recommend this experience!

Great getting to know people from around the world. Well run experience, sailing was great and skipper was fun and knowledgeable. Wind was too much to swim unfortunately but nothing anyone could do about that. Highly recommend!

What a wonderful boat experience! The waters were a little choppy, but our skipper, Ian, made us feel incredibly comfortable and safe while aboard. And he was so much fun to chat with, along with our other boat mates! Highly recommend to get out of the heat and hubbub of the city.

Great boa trip, great way to see Barcelona and a nice break from the heat. We got the sails out and unfortunately it was too rough to swim. (Not sure how it would ever be calmer though as we were out in the main med sea not a cove).

Sailing with captain Liz was a wonderful experience. She made us and all of her guests feel welcome and safe. As she motored the boat out of the harbor she cracked jokes and provided fun facts about the city of Barcelona. After we exited the harbor we sailed for a short time before Liz prepared the boat that allowed us to take a quick swim in the Med. The entire cruise was a relaxed and fun experience. My wife and I are glad we decided to beat the heat of the city and get out on the water during our honeymoon to Barcelona. It was a great way to see the city while enjoying some tapas and drinks.
Great team, great captain. Our daughter was afraid of the waves and they really took care. Well being and safety of people comes first. Then fun and drinks. Highly recommended.

This experience is absolutely amazing. our skipper Liz was incredible. She was very knowledgeable, kind, and funny. We had a great time seeing the marina and heading out into open water. The conditions were not right for swimming or sail but the view alone was worth it, not to mention the people running the boat.

This trip was magical. Our skipper Liz was so kind, personable, funny, caring, knowledgeable, safety and comfort minded. She gave us a superb experience. Rafael the first mate was absolutely wonderful as well. The ship was in tip-top shape and just gorgeous. Highly recommend this experience.

i can only recommend this tour, as it was magical to see the sunset from a sail boat.
also, we (the group of I think 8 people) were taken care of at all times with snacks and drinks and we were sometimes even asked if we want to have or need anything more.
It was my first time sailing and I felt very secure.

Enjoyed this sailing experience and was nice to see Barcelona from the sea. Water a a bit rough so we remained mostly in the harbour which was still enjoyable and relaxing. Our captain/skipper was very knowledgeable and clearly loves sailing, she was a very nice and considerate host.
Nora was a brilliant host, provided drinks and made everyone feel super welcome, she was also very knowledgeable and friendly and we had the most amazing time!

Good tour, our host was very friendly
And chatty and we had a good time, I wish we could have seen more of Barcelona’s coast but we sailed far away from it and could barely see anything. Overall was a nice experience, our glasses were always filled with cava and the group was very friendly..I would book it again
The tour is very good! A very quiet boat tour of the Barcelona sea, with drinks and appetizers at ease. Great opportunity to make new friends. Nora is very friendly! I recommend it to everyone

Are exceptional experience with professional captains.

In an impressive harbour location with lovely waters and view of the beach, city and mountains behind. An absolutely wonderful experience jumping into the Mediterranean ocean, if one wishes (bring a swimsuit).

Highly highly(!) recommend.
Really lovely sail around the harbor with time for a quick swim! Would recommend for anyone looking to get out of the city for a couple of hours!

Today we went on a boat tour with Nora with our creekwork. We were all absolutely delighted! We would 100% recommend the tour and if possible even give 6 stars. It was very relaxing and our wishes such as our own music and a swimming stop were accepted. Thank you very much for this unforgettable experience.

We had a great time. We were able to reschedule because it was too windy Friday when we were originally but Liese made it right by offering a refund or rescheduling to Sunday when she took out just our group of six. It was till pretty windy so we only went out a little distance. Regardless, it was a blast. Liese was expert and knowledgable and a pleasure to meet. Thank's Liese. Oh, yes, plenty of nice cava!

Great location for walking to many places, and only 1 block from a subway stop. Hosts Emiliano and Barbara are wonderful, and are quick to answer any questions. On multiple occasions we shared a drink or some coffee with them on the patio, and it felt like we were old friends.

Sailing was a beautiful way to see the city from afar! It was fairly windy on our sail and a light jacket was appreciated! Varvara provided drinks and snacks and was very friendly! I would definitely recommend this experience if you enjoy sailing!
This sailing experience was a fabulous time in Barcelona. It was well organized and refreshing, with Liz as the Captain/Clipper. Highly deserves 5 Stars!

So much fun! The captain & skipper are extremely charming, funny and know how to have a great time. I appreciated the safety-first guidelines before takeoff and enjoyed learning the Ins & outs of sailing while heading out to sea. Everyone was best friends after the Cava came out. The Mediterranean at sunset with a fun crew was a definitely a highlight! Glad I booked it.

Experience itself was nice, even if different from what I expected. The „help with sailing“ part felt oversold completely in the description (but then again there were only 2 maneuvers sailed in total). If u want to spend time on a sailingboat and enjoy wind and waves sitting back relaxing - that’s what you get here (different from what i experienced at similarily described experiences at other places). Captain was great and also attended to sea sick attendees in a super nice manner.

Pre-experience communication was unexpectedly bad for an airbnb experience. We were repeatedly reminded in a not-so-friendly tone to be no less than 15 min early or the boat would leave without us. Host didn’t arrive until 1min before the experience with no explanation and not reacting to any text before. Thanks to the security guard at the marina we knew that this was standard and we were infact not allowed on property any earlier.

Liz (our Belgian skipper) was very accommodating and helped to ensure we all had a good time. she was very passionate about sailing and shared many stories and observations. it was really nice to head out. unfortunately the wind was strong so we could not get in the water. but safety first and Liz made sure that was always the case!

The Trip was great! Unfortunately, we could not swim since the sea was a bit rough. But Liz made up for it with her great sense of humour and her interesting personality. What a nice afternoon! Recommend 100%!

The sailing was beautiful. Our captain was very friendly and we had a fun mix of people on the boat. Our only disappointment was that we were under the impression we would be able to swim however this was not offered. That said, the water was a little rough so in retrospect that was probably not a bad thing.

Great experience! Everything was well communicated and while onboard it was great meeting people and our sailer. We loved the complimentary snacks and drink. It is truly worth your money for a great experience. You’ll get to see a side of the city not often seen.

I ended up going on the other boat with Alex and she was so great. The water was super choppy and we weren’t able to stop the boat to swim, so that was a bit disappointing, but she made us all feel comfortable and was great to talk to. I would recommend watching the weather and then booking to have the best experience.
We had a blast even though the weather was not perfect, our host was very hospitable and made us feel like part of the crew. Also made sure our champagne glass was never empty 😉
Absolutely mangnificent experience. Victoria was such a wonderful captain and host. A great way to spend your evening if you are looking to meeting new people and see Barcelona from open sea.

Myself and my 5 friends had the boat to ourselves for my birthday and had the most wonderful time. Our skipper Victoria was lovely and welcoming and made sure we had the best time. It was a really fun experience would highly recommend!

Great value and an excellent way to meet new friends.

Victoria was a wonderful captain. She gave us interesting facts about the surrounding area, exchanged jokes, and listened intently when questioning our own backgrounds.

Unfortunately, one of our group was seasick and she handled it with compassion and grace.

Note to those who are prone to seasickness, take a tablet before embarking on the trip. The sea is fairly calm but the motion can get the best of you.

I would not hesitate to partake again.

We had a great time sailing with Vicky! The small size of our group made it possible to sit up front, and we really enjoyed seeing the full Barcelona skyline — beware if you get seasick though, eat before you go!

great boat ride to end the day, interesting meetings and exchanges, we were a couple and had a lovely time. very happy to have participated in this outing to the sea, along the Barcelona coast, exit the port to the Olympic to the Olympic towers. activity to do Barcelona

Our host Varvara was absolutely spectacular. She provided us with sailing knowledge, was a great skipper, served us refreshments, and got to know us each personally. The people onboard were especially friendly too. Couldn’t have asked for a better welcome into the city 😊
Very welcoming and professional. Well organised and nice! You have the chance to see Barcelona from the sea, and it is amazing. We really enjoyed the tour. Thank you guys!

We had an amazing trip on the sailing yacht! Great hosts who were really friendly. Just the right number of passengers too to get to know others but it wasn’t too crowded. Unfortunately we weren’t able to swim as it was too rough but we did see dolphins which was amazing!!

Victoria is absolutely amazing and hosted the most delightful sail on a beautiful vessel. We booked an evening sunset sail with her. She shared a lot of insightful knowledge of sailing with us as well as interesting info on Barcelona and insiders tips since she’s from the city. The boat was immaculate and well appointed. Quite spacious below also. She taught my husband and I how to pilot the boat and let us each have a go at it for awhile. Throughout the trip we had a nice spread of snacks and beverages. Overall a fantastic day with Victoria.
Vicky was our skipper and she was very nice! The waves were a bit wild but we all had a great time. Highly recommend !!

Vicki and Rafael were the best! They were very attentive to our needs and wanted to get to know us. They were very knowledgeable of the surrounding boats and businesses which made the trip more detailed and interesting.

I highly recommend this experience! I booked this trip for my family to experience the sunset on the water. The sailing itself was wonderful but Aline, our Skipper, added so much more! She was awesome with our rambunctious 6 year old and kept him very entertained throughout the trip. Unfortunately it was too choppy to swim but totally fine as the boat ride was awesome.

Crew was friendly, safe, and very concerned with our experience! Always filling our cava glasses and grabbing more beer. The water was such a beautiful color and felt great to jump in! Would definitely recommend this experience! Especially Alaine and Paul, they were great.

What an amazing experience. After a detailed safety briefing we were on our way. Alaine and Paul were both wonderful and knowledgeable, pointing out different landmarks you were able to see. And they both ensured our drinks were always full. 10/10 would recommend
This experience was above and beyond more than what we thought it was going to be. Simply great, made so many unforgettable connections and memories. Highly recommend this for anyone.

Our experience on the boat was above all of our expectations. We were so pleased that we are booking a SECOND trip with them while we are here in Barcelona! Thank you to the kind, friendly, and helpful staff who made this experience one that I will remember for life. Cheers!
Nice expérience to just travel around with a boat but there’s no story or explanations about Barcelona or anything, it’s just about sailing and drinking cava

I had a wonderful time on this sailing trip! I was travelling alone, and booked a day where others were already booked onto. We all had a great time getting to know one another and had a lovely sail - with a swim in the sea too! It was definitely one of my favourite experiences from my trip to Barcelona.
This was a wonderful experience. Very easy to find the meet up spot. Very relaxing time on the boat. Had wonderful conversation with the other passengers and the skipper. Definitely recommend!

This midday sail in Barcelona was absolutely one of our highlights of our trip! Captain Liz was such a delight, sailing us safely and comfortably along the Barcelona coast! The views were amazing and we even got to stop and swim a bit too. There was plenty of cava, wine, beer and snacks to go around and we made friends with the whole group on our boat! Truly our only complaint was that two hours was too short!! Highly recommend - no better way to see Barcelona than from the coast!!
I had so much fun on this experience, I would readily recommend to any family or friends. Our captain (liz) was hilarious and super informative / safe. I loved this time and made so many friends!!

This experience was such a highlight for my group in Barcelona. We had the best time at sea, got to go swimming and soak up the sun. Our captain Liz was so much fun and made for an extremely memorable experience. Definitely one of my favorite memories of our time in Barcelona.

I would say captain Liz ruined all my future cruises because I will compare them to this one.😆 She is just my type of person, witty, chill, and confident. She relaxed all of us, and because of it, it was super easy to connect and chat with other members. In return, we had a blast. I must say that I loved cava and that we had plenty. Also, taking a plunge from the boat was super fun. Traveling to Barcelona cannot go without this Airbnb experience. Thank you, guys!

Really enjoyed our sailing trip :) our skipper was very friendly and relaxed, happy to explain things about the boat to us and created a good atmosphere for everyone. Swimming in the sea was exciting too! Glad we did this and would recommend :)

Had an amazing time on this experience! Liz was the best captain, she was hilarious but also always made sure we were following safety protocols. Met great people on the boat, got to swim and overall had a great time! I would recommend this experience to anyone looking to have a good time with great people, especially if you’ve got Liz as your captain!!!

Boat was very nice and comfortable. The captain was very friendly and kind. It would have been nice to have an extra deck hand on the boat to help the captain or bring guests drinks and food while the captain is working, but that said it does feel more like being on a friends boat and not a tourist attraction so it’s nice. Everyone got to help learn to sail and help with all the boat items so we all learned about sailing. Overall awesome and I would do it again.

This was a brilliant boat trip which we would definitely go on again! Aline and Paul were great hosts, and all of the other guests on the boat were lovely too. Flowing cava and snacks!

The only thing that is worth mentioning is to make sure to message the host (in which you will receive an automated message from) before the trip to make sure that AirBnB has notified them about the booking!:)
We had a blast! It was a nice break from the city, and was lovely to see the city from a different perspective
Absolutely amazing experience! I would recommend anyone who wants to book to do so. Drinks flowing & sun shining. What more could you have asked for? Thanks so much for a lovely afternoon 😊
Amazing unique experience in the waters on the coast of Barcelona! Host was so friendly and made recommendations for the rest of the city. I'll be back!
Wonderful experience! Book this next time you’re in Barcelona to meet new friends, soak up beautiful views, and try Spanish wine and tapas

it was a pleasant 2 hour moment with the sunset. the food and drinks were of the cheapest quality (beer and some crackers with cheese). they split the larger group into 2 smaller groups to fit on their boats.
We did this on our last day in BCN and it was the BEST way to end our trip. Thank you all so much!!

Wish we could give this more than 5 stars!!!! 12 out of 10 experience with Liz tonight for sunset - amazing views, great conversation, tasty cava, and the whole experience was very comfortable. Really can’t say enough good things! If you love the water or sunsets or having fun you must do this tour in Barcelona.
Our skipper Liz was fabulous! We had a great time sailing in Barcelona. She always made sure our glasses were full! 10/10 would recommend/do again!

This is just great if you’re looking for a sail just off the coast and a chance to swim. We had impeccable weather, so I’m suggesting this month would probably be the best time to go. Our skippers Connor and Peter were awesome and accommodating to our needs, and with our good group on board, it made for a fantastic two-hour getaway!
I highly recommend this to anyone who is looking for some water adventure on the amazing coasts of Barcelona! Amazing value and friendly guides!

This was truly an amazing experience and must do activity when visiting Barcelona. The weather was incredible, there was plenty of cava and tapas to go around, and chatting with the other guests was a lot of fun!

Connor was a great host!
The trip itself was wonderful, Barcelona on a boat is a must seen. The snacks and drinks were very much welcomed and made our trip perfect!
We loved the private tour as a family!

It was such a great experience. Lisa and Rafael did a really great job, our sailing experience was amazing.. They both know what they were doing. There were lots of drinks and tapas as well. Would love to come back and have the same experience.

It's a great experience that's worth sharing and experiencing. Our hosts (Raphael and Paddy) were considerate and pleasant. Everything is done to ensure relaxation and enjoy the moment. The tapas were nice, alcohol, or soft on will.
Thank you for your exceptional time

This definitely added up to our Barcelona experience. We got to see the city from the sea and cool off in the water. The weather was AMAZING! And nothing better than eating tapas and drinking wine and champagne. I would definitely do it again!
Very windy day and we weren’t able to go for a swim. Otherwise, Crew was nice but we didn’t really get a tour of the coastline, it was definitely a sail out for 30 minutes and sail back in situation

Definitely recommend! Varvara was very knowledgeable, and always put safety first! I met new friends and the ride and views were spectacular! Peter was amazing at making sure our glasses never went empty.

Loved the experience. Victoria was great at making us feel safe and comfortable and made sure our glass was never empty!! The views form the boat are beautiful and the sunset was quite nice to see from the sea.
Incredible experience, the captain was so great and was happy to chat and tell us anything we wanted to know. Would 100% recommend this!
Just book it. This is a great experience and a great value. Open bar and snacks on the water?! It was perfect. Host was very accommodating. Pro Tip: Do this the first day if your traveling alone :)
Experience was nice overall. Was very windy and didn’t get to experience the whole calm sailing vibe. But Victoria was an excellent sailor and always kept our glasses full! 😊
Victoria was our Captain, and she was wonderful. Very pleasant, very knowledgeable, and we get very safe with her. We would book this again in a hot minute.
Eduardo was a fantastic skipper, so attentive to the whole group and full of great stories!! Definitely book this experience if you have the chance!!

This was such a great experience! If you second guessing, do NOT! We had so much drinks & snacks and had lots of fun conversing & enjoying the view/experience. A great value for what you get & I think the time spent is also a perfect amount! Not too long or not too short. It was amazing book immediately!! Thank you Eduardo for being such an amazing host & making sure we were able being taken care of.

Fantastic experience with Richard and Piter who were hosting our boating trip. Nothing better than making new friends with champagne, swimming, and relaxing on our sailboat. The value was excellent and i thought the timing of 2 hours was perfect - we wouldn’t hesitate to book again. Finally, the number of guests was perfect and we felt like there was plenty of space to spread out and socialize. Muchas gracias!
This was a wonderful experience! We were able to swim and explore Barcelona in a new way! We also met lots of new people. Snacks and drinks were provided as well!

What an amazing experience! Victoria was the best captain we could have asked for. She was so charming, welcoming, and funny! We went on this ride for my friend’s birthday and the memories will last forever. I highly recommend.

We had such a relaxed trip and fun time! Our host was very kind and generous, and we just loved getting to know everyone on the boat while enjoying some beautiful views, soaking up the sun, and swimming. :)
We had a wonderful time on this experience. Great value, great hosts, and a great setting. Would highly recommend to others and would definitely do again!
Aline is a lovely host. my friend and I had a great time on board drinking some delicious Cava and enjoying breath taking sunset.

This is the most amazing tour you can take! You will be happy, see amazing views and leave in awe. I cannot recommend this enough. Aline and Stefan were amazing and the guests that came along also made the trip special! Do it!

This was an incredible experience! We had Liz as our captain and she was fantastic. The communication was clear, the drinks and food were great, and we were lucky enough to get to go for a swim. We loved it so much we tried to book again but they were sold out haha! Thanks so much and especially to Liz!

Liz was our captain and she was AMAZING! She explained all the safety measures really well and in an accessible way. Usually that’s very overwhelming for me.

Snacks and drinks were good too and free flowing basically . We had free reign of the boat so we could take all the pictures and spread out. And generally be super relaxed.

Going in the water is dependent upon wind and conditions. We had excellent wind so we could actually sail! (but couldn’t go in the water, which was perfectly fine) .

Definitely would book this trip again !
Liz and Rafael were great they were funny and very chill but always made sure we were safe when sailing. I would definitely recommend this to anyone going to Barcelona.

it was fun! we toured around the coast of Barcelona and got to see the skyline from the city from a new perspective. we learned something new about sailing and could get involved on the boat if we wanted. we had perfect weather. had great snacks and drinks. really nice afternoon on the water!

Very good activity, we had at the base on Saturday night but following a problem on the harbour it was postponed on Monday noon, and I want to say so much better we were able to swim, feast at the aperitif with unlimited drinks. The mobility on the sailboat is almost total. The hosts were lovely, unprecedented experience giving us a different view of Barcelona!

Very nice captain. Liz made sure to take care of our needs and was more than happy to explain and show us the sailing lifestyle. These two hours were full of laughter, sun and relaxation… and champagne ;).
Our captain Liz made us feel very welcome and was always up for a chat with the guests! The champagne was delicious, the other people easygoing and the overall experience is definitely recommendable.

Had a tour with Viki and Rafael, and all I can say it was absolutely amazing experience. Reading the reviews before booking the trip I had my expectations high, and they were all fulfilled plus extra. Definitely an activity worthy of visiting :)

Experience met our expectations. We had a pleasant time. The staff is very professional.
The aperitif is very good.

Thanks to Valeria and Raphael for this wonderful experience.

Great sailing experience. Was really cool to be on our own boat which had a max capacity of 10 people. We did not get to see a sunset due to clouds but the experience was still great nonetheless. Would highly recommend!
Good experience. Was cloudy so we couldn’t see much, and the waves were a bit choppy. Would have been better on a clear day. Other than that our guide was great.
What an amazing experience! Lovely snacks and drinks provided on a beautiful boat. Would highly recommend - one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona!

This was a lovely evening! The skipper was so sweet and very experienced. The views were beautiful and we met couples from all over the world! We felt safe the entire time and would highly recommend this experience.

This boat tour was amazing! Our skipper and her assistant were amazing during our whole experience. They greeted us with small appetizers and drinks and kept supplying us with drinks during the whole boat ride! Unfortunately the waves were very rough during the day so we weren’t able to go swimming during the trip, but the views from the boat were amazing. Towards the end of the boat ride, we were able to sit in the front of the boat once the waves were not as rough. Everyone on our boat was super nice and friendly as well!

Great experience! This was my first time on a sailboat and I absolutely loved it! It seemed a little short since we were sailing and didn’t get out too far but the views were amazing! They had yummy snacks and they kept my glass full the entire time! We also had the opportunity to meet other travelers. I would do it again!

This was such an awesome experience. Vicki and Alberto were exceptional skippers, and took the time to explain everything to us. They were also VERY generous with the Kava (or anything else you’d want to drink). I can say that kava makes a better ship captain! Very knowledgeable crew, they gave us great recommendations for the rest of our time in Barcelona as well. 100% would recommend this trip!
It was a very pleasant and pleasant experience. The kava you prepared was so delicious. I was able to finish my trip with a beautiful sunset in Barcelona. A precious experience😌✨💓

Charming boat cruise. Had some cool people on the boat with us so conversation was great, including with our skipper who was lovely. The bar definitely was open, and our skipper ensured we always had a drink in our hand (if we so desired). Also got to participate in the sailing which produced some good photos. Would recommend to anyone 👍
The best thing we did in Barcelona. Truly a remarkable experience and we met wonderful new people aboard the boat. Would do this excursion 100x over.

Liz was the most amazing captain—engaging, attentive, and safety-focused. This trip far exceeded our expectations in terms of beauty, relaxation, engagement, and socialization. Would book again and again. Special cheers to our amazing captain, Liz!

This was a perfect sailing experience - I highly recommend. The skipper was awesome and super friendly, the company was very fun and there were delicious drinks and snacks. And plus I even got to participate in some sailing.

The trip by boat was extremely nice. We had rented the boat privately.
The staff were really very friendly. I can only recommend it.

We had a great experience sailing before Barcelona harbor with super skipper Vicky! Wow, this lady single handedly took care of the boat, the snacks, the drinks and safety! Views of the skyline were great!
This was an amazing experience. Anyone traveling to Barcelona should put this as #1 on their list of things to do. The boat was clean and fun. The environment created by the captains was even better.

This cruise was very fun and a good value. Mattia and Pieter were great skippers. Drinks were great, snacks were a bit simplistic but good. Great views, and lots of beautiful views from the seaside! Would do again!
The hosts (Martine and Eduardo) were amazing hosts and did a great job keeping us entertained. The sailing was beautiful and we had a great time!
Amazing experience! Best view of the sunset you could ever ask for and awesome meeting people from different cultures. Gracious and welcoming hosts that made for an awesome sail! Recommend booking !

Very nice sunset sail! The skipper was very friendly and attentive to our needs, whether it was mor snacks, beverage, or blankets. He pointed out the main sites and some of the group had great conversation while others chose to spread out beyond the benches and just enjoy the beautiful view!
The captain and her assistant are lovely and very friendly. We enjoyed this walk despite the mixed weather. To be repeated with the sun!

What an amazing experience for our party of 6. We didn’t know what to expect as it seemed cheap for what was included. We can all agree however it has been the highlight of our trip. We had some snacks and bottomless cava it appeared! Could simply not recommend this experience with Varvara and co assistant Paul enough. Definitely book this! You don’t want to miss this experience.
Super hosts/boaters! Despite the rainy day, this was a fantastic experience in which everyone was ready to make us as comfortable as possible. Nice way to meet new people!
We had a great time, staff was friendly, however we were told not to jump in the water as its dangerous. This was contradictory to what we were told about bringing a bathing suit.

It was a beautiful sail! Everyone on board was so nice. The wine and conversation was flowing. We were able to sit up front. It was too cold and rocky to swim but that was fine with us. There were no bathrooms for use on board but they let us know and let us go to the public washrooms before we left.

Make sure to hold onto something when walking around. The waves can get big!
Had a great time with my friends sailing on the boat with amazing views. We shared the boat with some lovely strangers from around the world. Would definitely recommend!

Went on this boat experience with a group of friends in the evening, super friendly hosts who made us feel welcomed and we even made a few friends with the other guests on the boat too. Would recommend as a fun activity to do in the nice weather!

We just returned from our sailing with Vicky! She was an awesome captain and our experience was better than we expected. We met a couple from the US and one from South Africa and had a great time together. Food and drink was well prepared! We give our highest praise for this experience! With thanks to all!! Lisa (and crew)

The boat experience was truly magical and will be an unforgettable moment of our holiday. Victoria and Raffael were amazing host and really knowledgeable. They made the experience unforgettable through their hospitality and even teaching us about sailing. This is a must do if you come to Barcelona!

Absolutely wonderful experience! We were on with a great group. Love they keep it to 10. Nicki and Raphael created such a peaceful and fun atmosphere. We had wine, cava, beer, and snacks. Water was too rough to jump in but so great that is an option when possible as well.

Captain Lise made this experience very memorable. She was kind and attentive to our needs. I would recommend any group to book a private boat with her. Alan was also super welcoming and generous with his time.

A great boat trip, view from the harbor of the coast, the skippers are very welcoming and Rumba the small dog of the boat,very cuddly. Great value for money, at sunset, a magical moment! Thank you again!
Our skipper was very nice and knowledgeable. Great experience for the price. Very easy to meet up with the hosts and pictures are provided for the meet up point.

Great experience to enjoy Barcelona from a different view! Everything was pretty well organized. The only thing is that the experience lasted 2 hours including leaving and entering the port (about 30’min) you might consider extending it ;)

I went on this activity with my friend and it was honestly the best decision. The crew was so nice, we had amazing conversations about pretty much anything and everything. She made sure everyone was comfortable at all times, even for one of the guests that was a little scared of the water. Never let our glasses empty. Truly an amazing experience with an even more amazing captain.

We booked the sunset cruise and it was really one of our best experiences in Barcelona! The captain was amazing, nice view of the city skyline with a glass of cava … just perfect. And there was so much ambiance with the other guest. I really recommend it and would definitely do it again!

A wonderful late afternoon sail ... well, motor (there was very little wind!), but it was awesome! The captain, Eduardo was funny, kind, and cheeky and his "first mate" Paul was very attentive. Fun group of people, delicious meat & cheese spread and refills of cava! We got to go swimming off the boat because the sea was calm. highly recommend!
This was a really fun experience to do in Barcelona! It was a gorgeous day and getting to have snacks and drinks on the boat and even swim in the water was so great. I recommend!

The experience was supposed to be 2 hours, but the hosts were late to pick up us from meeting spot and we ended up only being on the boat for an hour. As for the boat, was a great experience! The host never let our glasses get empty and we’re very friendly! Weather was great, but when you go out to the sea the water gets a bit rocky.

Wonderful experience. I booked the sunset cruise two days prior with Eduardo who was an amazing host. Sailing the Mediterranean a the sun goes down was beautiful. Such a wonderful experience that I booked midday with Vicki who is a very kool skipper and passionate about the work. Vicki and Eduardo ensured the their passengers had a great experience. Both excursions were the highlight of my trip.

definitely a must when in Barcelona. beatiful views both inside the port and out at the sea, great people and well chilled drinks :) our captain Nora took good care of us during the journey, couldn’t wish for anything more. highly recommend!

This was an excellent trip!
very friendly people and excellent value!

our glasses were kept full of cava and we got to jump in the sea also.

I highly recommend it to all.

kenny

incredible hosting skills. Made us feel so relaxed and made every part of the trip so enjoyable. thank you! The boat was amazing and being able to jump off the boat and swim was a particular highlight
The sunset sail was great! We saw some beautiful views of the city at night and enjoyed the cava and snacks. Highly recommend.

This sunset sail was very fun! We had great views of the coast of Barcelona at sunset which we enjoyed with some tasty snacks and plenty of Cava 🙂. The hosts were friendly and clear about the safety instructions on the boat.
We absolutely loved our experience! We sailed with Eduardo and Paul and they were very entertaining and made sure everything went smoothly. I would definitely go again and recommend it to others :)

It was amazing ! Liz and Allan (sorry for misspelling) were very cool, making the experience absolutely special. Very friendly and warm atmosphere and we were lucky to have amazing weather. We also met some amazing people and became good friends with, highlight of the trip for sure.

honestly was the best thing I have experienced! Liz was incredible and enjoyed every second of it! Daniella also who was volunteering was attentive and amazing! couldn't recommend this experience enough. before we set sail I wanted to do it again!

This experience was absolutely incredible. Anybody who is in Barcelona needs to book this experience!! I met so many cool people (including Liz, our captain)! She was very welcoming and knowledgeable and made our experience truly one of a kind!! I will never forget our time on the boat. if you are hesitating, don’t! BOOK THIS EXPERIENCE :)

Met some incredible people and the views were lovely. We didn't get to swim unfortunately so make sure not to be misled by the photos! The food and drink provided were great and our skipper Lis was extremely wonderful!
Hosts were super welcoming and fun. Also spoke great english and we got clear instructions about were to come. Service was awesome and drinks were always cold. Great recommendation!!!

I highly recommend sailing with them! Victoria (Vicky) was our skipper for the day and my mom and I truly enjoyed every moment. It was lovely to see Barcelona from the sea and enjoy the weather. I even navigated a bit and loved it.

Experience to try, super helpful and nice staff
Too bad for the fog but on a clear day it can only be even better
A lovely sail off the coast of Barcelona. Our captain, Liz, was great - personable, fun, and she kept the champagne flowing. One of our best evenings in Barcelona.
This was an unbelievable experience! Liz was an amazing skipper and so much fun to talk to. If you have the opportunity, do this experience you won’t regret it!!

Amazing amazing amaaaazzzinggg! 100% recommend! I throughly enjoyed our trip with Liz and Rafael :) they were amazing people and we met new friends on the boat! Also, they made sure that our glass was never empty and also the snack plate was a plus! Thank you so much for the experience! If you’re thinking about booking, just do it! :)
There are multiple boats and skippers, but ours was fantastic! Very friendly and personal. They were so quick to serve drinks and answer questions, along with inquiring about the guests as well!

Great experience, I recommend it!
A beautiful sunset and a very pleasant atmosphere. The duration of the experience (2 hours) is perfect.
Vicki is welcoming, she offers to go to the front of the boat and even hold the bar!
Top memorable photos!
So worth booking! The price is unbeatable! You get those stunning views, drinks and even snacks😍We had a blast on the Sunset cruise and even met new friends on board.

Boats are in great condition. Very comfortable, lots of great Spanish drinks. Our skipper “Vicki” was so much fun and very easy to talk to. She told us great fun facts and stories about Barcelona and she made the experience so much better. The value of the overall experience is excellent. Easy to coordinate, easy to find, great staff and other participants. Highly recommend if you’re considering it.
Amazing experience ! Nicki and Raphael were the best ! I SUPER customer service experience, super ride, super everything ! LOVED IT <3

Onboard the ride with Vicky! Vicky was a great host as she constantly checked in with us to ensure we are well and comfortable, enjoying the ride! Vicky also interacted with the group, shared her knowledge generously & welcomed kids to join in the fun. The ride showed a beautiful sunset view of Barcelona!

This experience was so much fun! An amazing view and the crew were really nice and genuinely interested in chatting with you. It was such a great time for my friends and we had a great afternoon :) Definitely recommend booking this if you want a relaxing afternoon!
This was such a great way to unwind and see the city from the water. They were gracious and lovely. Put safety first and made sure we enjoyed ourselves.

We had such a great time aboard with Varvara and Tom. We met lots of lovely people who joined us on the experience and we were welcomed with nibbles and refreshments. The boat was very nice and the experience was one to remember! Thank you ⛵️😊
Amazing experience highly recommend! Staff were super lovely and the snacks and drinks were a lovely bonus as well. Thank you so much!

I had originally reserved for the Thursday evening trip but got lost finding the place, eventually missing the event. Your team was very helpful in reassuring me that I would get to experience this beautiful boat trip and was able to attend the next day. It was amazing as anticipated and the customer service offered was well above any expectation I had. Thank you very much!! I recommended it to all of my friends for whenever they come to Barcelona.

We had a fantastic time sailing in the Mediterranean off of beautiful Barcelona. Pretty straight forward trip - no exhaustive historical tour (though some fun tidbits were added) just relaxing and enjoying some tapas and drinks on a boat in crystal clear waters. We also couldn't pass up the chance to swim in the Mediterranean despite how cold the water was! Great time - would definitely recommend!
One of the most amazing experiences i have lived. If you are a Barcelona this is a must. The host was amazing and welcoming. It was a beautiful experience.

What a great way to spend our first afternoon in Barcelona! A few hours on the water with a great weather, a wonderful crew and friendly companions. Eduardo and Tom were knowledge, friendly and responsive. The beer, wine and cava free flowing. It was a great afternoon. I would do it again to see the city at Sunset.
We loved our sailing tour. ⛵️ The crew members were great and super welcoming. We highly recommend this activity to enhance your stay in Barcelona.
Victoria was a great host all night. Great storytelling, amazing views, and first-class hospitality. We felt so happy we were able to make it because this was the highlight of our trip. Thank you!

This experience was GREAT! Well worth the money. We got lucky and there were only 4 of us on the boat so it felt very private. Liz & Tom were absolutely fantastic and let us be involved in raising & lowering the sails and driving which was really fun! The only thing that was a bummer is that it was “too windy” to stop and jump off the boat & swim. We still definitely enjoyed ourselves and would do this again if we go back!
She did a great job. The day was perfect, the hospitality outstanding, the boat was in fine condition. I had a great time.
Tom and Liz were fabulous hosts and so easy to relate to despite all of us being from different countries. Drinks were flowing and the backdrop was gorgeous !

WOW! Do not hesitate to book this experience! It was absolutely incredible. The boat and views were lovely and our skipper, Liz, was fantastic. It was a joy to sail with her and she provided a very comfortable and welcoming environment (with champagne!). Do not leave Barcelona before you sailing with her!
Varvara was a great host, it was my first time being on a boat and she made the experience great. 10/10 would book again.
We had a great time! Our skipper Vicky was wonderful! She provided plenty of snacks and drinks. And she was very knowledgeable about Barcelona. Would definitely do it again.

Great afternoon & highlight of our trip going out on the boat with Liz! Very relaxing & fun experience - even got a chance to drive the boat! We weren't able to swim on the day due to bad currents/wind but didn't damper the experience :)

Eduardo and Tom were amazing hosts and went above and beyond for our group. I could not recommend this experience enough, it was truly the highlight of my Barcelona trip. Thank you so much for such wonderful memories!
Edouardo and Tom were excellent hosts! The folks on the boat came from all over and we were laughing from start to finish. Thanks for a great time!

Incredible experience - felt safe and taken care of the entire time. The views and intimate experience of this boat totally made our trip. We rode past one of the larger commercial boat tours, and it looked so crowded compared to ours. The crew were so nice - plenty of drinks and snacks - and our fellow passengers were fun, too.

This is a magical experience and an unbelievable way to end a day in Barcelona. We did the sunset experience and our crew was so friendly and accommodating for our group. They really went the extra mile to make sure that every guest was comfortable and happy on the cruise. Of course, the scenery is gorgeous and seeing Barcelona from the Sea is something everyone visitor should do.
Amazing tour! Beautiful view of the city and amazing tour guides. Vicky was lovely! Helpful and also super fun. Unlimited drinks were awesome! Had a great swim and met great people!

A really lovely way to spend our last evening in Barcelona enjoying drinks and tapas. The scenery of the sea and port were beautiful and we were able to swim for a bit in the lovely fresh water. The guides were great fun and made us feel very relaxed and safe. Would definitely recommend and well worth the spend!

Stepan was very knowledgeable and very accommodating. He will teach you how to actually use a kayak well so that you can go to special places that other tours won’t go. He also even took directly back to our Airbnb after the tour. 10/10 would Highly recommend. If your debating wether or not to do this trip just book it right now you won’t be disappointed.

This was such a great end to our trip to Barcelona! The sea was very calm and it was a beautiful evening with a great view of the city. Drinking cava and talking to a great group of people was very relaxing. The crew was very attentive and knowledgeable about sailing! Highly recommend this experience!

This was an exceptional experience, one that we will never forget. Both captains very extremely welcoming and we all had a wonderful time. Words really cannot describe how amazing this sailing trip was. We would be more than happy to do this again! Thank you for having us!

Would definitely do it again and would recommend it to all my friends! Sailors were extremely personable and did everything to make sure everyone was safe and feeling comfortable on the boat. 10/10 experience!
Liz and Marc were great hosts and very funny. It was a relaxing experience with friendly service. Definitely a must do if you’re in Barcelona.

It was my first time being on a sailboat, I wish the weather was warmer. However, Varvara and staff made me feel welcomed. I felt relaxed listening to the ocean while drinking cava. I had fun when she had me steering the boat. I would do this again but I recommended it when the weather is warmer.
The actual sailing was a lovely experience. We had a bad weather, but of course the hosts can't do anything about it. There should have been more to serve.

Nice trip! We did a sailing trip with the kids. It was a bit of a bad weather, but that wasn't someone's fault. The staff was friendly. They served snacks and drinks. The snacks ran out immediately and no more came in. There was wine and beer for adults, a lemonade for the kids. The sailboat was great.

Best experience! We took great care and shared a pleasant time with other people from different countries. Unlimited aperitif and we were fortunate enough to have beautiful weather and a little sunset! You can move around the Yacht freely. I recommend the experience.
Great experience. The 2 guys who ran it were really easy going & very attentive especially when it came to topping up our drinks.
We had a great time going on a sunset cruise. Although it was cloudy, the skyline at night is beautiful. We also had great conversations with folks from around the world. Would absolutely recommend!

My parents and I had a great time with the amazing views and food bites. We enjoyed the group we were with as we began to have small talks with each other. In regard with the meetup location, it was self explanatory and easy to find! I would definitely recommend this experience. P.S it does get a bit windy so bring a extra sweater or cover up!
It was amazing to sail from Port Vell, definitely something you should try in Barcelona! You can't miss getting to know your hosts

Great time! It was tricky to find the meet up location, so read the directions carefully and plan to get there early. You don't want to miss this fun excursion! I would go again every time I come to Barcelona, thank you!

Such a great experience! As a solo traveler I felt completely safe on this experience, and our host and skipper were both very nice. The communication was very clear on meeting spot/time, and the boat ride was so beautiful. Highly recommend.

Our 2 best hours in Barcelona were probably spent on the ship with Varvara. Really a magical experience and a must-do while in the city. What would be a better way to see Barcelona, then from a coast while sipping drinks with great people? 10/10
This was an excellent couple hours spent on sea. Victoria was our captain, and she made it such a memorable time for us.

I loved it. The hostess was fun, charming and with a similar taste of humor. The whole trip was comfortable and I got to meet new people, take nice pictures and enjoy the cava & sunset. Loved it. Thank you!

We had a great time on this experience! Even though it was overcast when we went out, we hardly noticed the sun was missing because we were too busy enjoying the sailing and making new friends on the boat. Our captain was knowledgeable, amicable, and made sure we were briefed on safety measures before heading out. The snacks and drinks were lovely as well:) Would definitely recommend!
I had so much fun on this sail! They had snacks + drinks for us and I made lot’s of friends on board. We ended up having dinner afterwards together.

We thoroughly enjoyed our experience! Victoria was very welcoming and made sure everything was comfortable for our trip. She made it personal by telling story’s of her own boating experiences, sharing her knowledge of Barcelona and letting us meet her lovely dog Kiko. She also let my friends hoist the sail which was lovely. The group element is great as you can meet new people and share the experience. Would definitely recommend!

Great sailing on the sea with a super loving and likeable hostess. Although we were clearly (!) late, Vicky waited for us and took us and took us very well. It really was a very nice and relaxing experience! Get out of the bustling city and enjoy the tranquility of the lake with good drinks and very nice conversations. Really highly recommended! Muchísimas gracias Vicky!!

This was maybe the highlight of my entire trip in Barcelona! The pilot was incredibly nice and funny, the views are unbelievable, and we were even provided drinks and snacks! The boat was clean and sturdy and the experience, from finding the meet up point to departure, was seamless and easy!

Great experience overall. Had a good time. You start sitting a bit cramped in the back of the boat, but snacks and beers/wine were brought out before pushing out from the dock.
The captain was very nice, knowledgeable, and friendly.

Once we were out of the harbor we were allowed to move around to the front - take a few photos, etc. The wind was very cold which no one was expecting as it was pretty hot out all day - so bring a jacket during the spring months.

Had a lot of fun!
Such a wonderful experience. Being in the sea with a glass of cava and making new friends. What more can you ask for?

I booked this boats trip for the birthday of my friend and we both really enjoyed the time there! Although it was very windy there was a nice atmosphere including drinks and tapas. :-) We also met some very nice new people. I would definitely book this boats trip again!😎
Amazing experience! It was fun, we got to meet new people, and the host was so fun! Our drinks were full the entire time, and it was a perfect experience to end our trip. 100% recommend :)

I loved this! It was picturesque and everything I imagined it would be. My group was seated in a way that it was easy to get the conversation flowing. The other thing that was flowing was the cava!! She kept topping off our glasses and we all just had a great time. Bring a light jacket because it is windy out on the water. I would have paid double for this - worth every Euro!

The weather can't affect anyone - always remember!!! For this, that we were alone with Varvara as the only crew member on the ship, a first-class service and very customer oriented. Nice trip. Recommended.

This was such an amazing time. The weather was a bit chilly, so we couldn’t swim but were provided blankets, drinks and snacks to keep toasty. The view was incredible. I highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Barcelona.

We had a wonderful time on board. We sailed along the coastline and our skipper, Vicky, made sure we felt comfortable and well taken care of. She even let my son steer the boat, so he had a great experience, too. We can highly recommend the experience.

Vicky was so nice! She really made sure that we were all comfortable and having fun! I (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) % recommend booking this activity ! We had great tapas and she made sure our glasses were always full of delicious cava

Definitely would book this again. Awesome experience. Hospitality on the sail boat by the skipper was great. Kept us filled with beer and Champaign. She also gave a lot of helpful tips when staying in Barcelona. She knew a lot of cool details on high roller yacht owners. Made some friends on the boat. Great value for the 2 hours you get out there.
The boat itself was nice and we enjoyed getting out on the water, but didn’t feel our expectations were met, especially for the cost it was.

Could not recommend enough - best part of the holiday. Lovely boat and cava!! Made so many fun memories and was great to make friends with other travellers. Vicky was so friendly and accommodating. Thank you!

This was a great experience that capped off our trip to Barcelona. The light appetizers were a nice tough, and we had plenty to drink as well. We were also lucky enough to have a simultaneous sunset and moonrise, which was a nice touch. As others have said, though, it does get a bit chilly, so dress appropriately!
had a nice trip which we‘ve booked very spontaneous. Crew was funny and lovely and there‘ve been enough drinks for everyone. Was great. Would recommend

We had the best time on our mid day sailing trip! It was a bit too cold to go into the water but laying out in the sun and watching the Barcelona skyline was a dream. The snacks and drinks were delicious and our host kept them coming. Highly recommend for a wonderful afternoon out on the Mediterranean!
sailing through the sunset while seeing barcelona's beauty was truly a magical experience. the snacks and the conversation were a great touch as well!
The yacht ride was a wonderful experience! It’s a fantastic opportunity to meet new people, and the view of Barcelona when coming back to the dock at night is lovely.
We lucked out with beautiful weather and had a great time. Our skipper was very informative and friendly, and we enjoyed meeting the other guests on this experience.

Varvara was great! Unfortunately the weather didn’t cooperate so we couldn’t sail like we expected but the experience was still wonderful. We toured the marina, made new friends on the boat and loved seeing the sunset from the water. Can’t wait to go sailing next time we come back! Thank you for a lovely evening Varvara!
Our host was so nice to visit with, the boat was beautiful and comfortable, the food and drink were perfect. What's not to love?
It was nice but we did have some rough waters due to wind on the day that we went. Varvara was very nice and gave us some suggestions on where to eat and explore.
This was such a fun experience, even with waves which made it difficult to go out far. Varvara was a lovely and knowledgeable host. I would highly recommend this experience when visiting Barcelona!
Would recommend for a nice relaxing way to see the city from a different view. It was a low of fun being on the boat and we took some great pictures.
Absolutely book this trip! The hosts are amazing. It's beautiful and great value for money. I went out with my three kids (tweenagers) for my birthday and it was an unforgettable experience. xx

Great experience. Even though the weather was bad and we didn’t get to go out sea, we were still able to cruise around the port and enjoy drinks and snacks. Would definitely book when i visit Barcelona again in the future!
It was a great experience! The captain was very kind and friendly. We have a good communication with the journey! There are free snacks and drinks, and the sea view is great. Very exciting!
Great boat ride around Barcelona. Staff was nice and gave us food and drinks. It was a good amount of time and really enjoyed it

Great idea for an experience and I’m sure most people would have a wonderful time. Unfortunately our experience was slightly ruined by the fact that we couldn’t go out to the high seas as other guests on the boat were unable to handle the waves and we had to return to the pier almost immediately. Additionally, I would recommend not mentioning politics in the conversation as the views held may not agree with everyone. It was a shame as the experience had lots of potential to be far better and we were just unlucky.
Excellent value for your money, will definitely be back if in Barcelona again. Met a great group of new friends, won’t soon forget experience!!
Nice trip, wonderful view of Montjuic Hill. Unfortunately due to wind we couldn't sailing to open sea such long. Capitan was great host. She told us about Barcelona life andsailing experience.
We had the best time on the sunset cruise! Something we will remember for a very long time, Victoria was so friendly and made our experience amazing. Would highly recommend!

It was a great, fun-tastic experience.
The pilot of the boat is kind, approachable and very experienced.
I will recommend Varvara to my friends who will come for a holiday here in Spain.
This was a nice trip around the port and then out a short way into the deeper water. Great views of Montjuic. Good excursion for a small party.

The boat trip itself was good and the host was great once on the boat but I had to wait an hour to be collected from the meeting point. One hour is precious time when you want to explore the rest of the city and you are only staying for a little while. I would have expected to get a part refund for the inconveniences. The issues for late pick up were explained but it doesn’t excuse it- a bit unprofessional I have to say.

The tour with Viktoria was nice: she explained it to the best of her possibilities and was genuinely intersted in her guests.
Important: we didn't leave the bay (so no full sea). Very cheap tapas were offered.
We did not have the impression she was able to manage the job alone.

We really enjoyed this experience and truly recommend to everyone visiting Barcelona. For future guests, we recommend including more information about the areas we are sailing to add more depth to the tour (pointing things out where they are, etc) in addition to sailing. We were also surprised that we were strongly encouraged to not use the bathroom below deck as it wasn’t a good experience. It would be ideal to have that option in future tours. Nonetheless, it was a great memory and we think many people will enjoy this tour! Beautiful views, drinks and light apps, and a lovely sunset.
We highly recommend this activity for everyone! You really get to see the city from another point of view! The city lights are magical when they’re reflected on the water!
Varvara was such an amazing host and the experience was one of a kind! Definitely one of the best parts of our trip :)
The apartment was great and very clean. Its the perfect place to go with a group of friends and the location is amazing!

The yacht experience was really great. We loved it so much! Victoria (the skipper) was lovely too. We spent a great time with her on the yacht. They offered drinks and snacks which was great. We had campagne and some snacks which made our experience spectacular. We would love to go again when we’ll be back again in Barcelona for another vacation. Go for it guys you will spend an awesome time.

We went on the midday cruise on our first day in Barcelona and could not have asked for a better start to our vacation. The boat was clean with plenty of space to store jackets and small bags downstairs as well as a bathroom downstairs. There was plenty of room for the owners, my group, and another group on the boat. We got some awesome pictures on a beautiful sunny day. This was an open bar experience and the hosts were more than prepared with beer, wine, and cava. There were a few snacks, only thing I would change is maybe some more snacks as it wasn’t enough for both groups. The hosts told us amazing stories and were extremely friendly and welcoming. Would definitely book again if I return to Barcelona.
Great experience! No issues at all, we played our music on the sailing trip and it was the best way to end our holiday 💖

They were able to accommodate both my boyfriend and I even though the booking only allowed one slot left. We love that we were able to experience this! 10000% recommend going during sunset bc it is GORGEOUS! It was chilly with the strong waves, but if you're going in the peak of Summer, it will be a blast. 10/10 would come back in the future (during Summer) to experience this again! Oh, and the snacks were awesome :) We had Victoria and Tina as our crew and absolutely LOVE them! They are fun with great conversation! They always made sure we had everything we needed. My boyfriend went through five beers during this hahaha thank you!!

Great experience! It was very very windy on our trip but it didn’t stop us from having fun! The champagne was flowing & the snacks were very good! We were even allowed to steer the boat if we wanted to. We saw beautiful sights & were able to take in the beauty of Barcelona from the water!

What an amazing experience. Vicky’s knowledge of Spanish/Catelonian history was incredible. Not to mention that she is an extremely accomplished captain.
We loved everything about this trip. The cava and tapas were delicious and the icing on the cake

Anna and Alex were wonderful hosts. They were very friendly, accommodating and very knowledgeable about the history of Barcelona. The drinks and tapas were very tasty and plentiful! Highly recommended!

Varvara and Alexander were such warm and welcoming hosts, who provided a detailed instruction on what to expect in a timely manner, which made everything so easy and smooth for my large group of 10 people.

Victoria was our skipper for the day and she was beyond amazing and lovely...She gifted us such unforgettable memories and took a great care of us during the entire sailing experience despite of the fact that most of us were non-English speaking travellers...!! My group just wouldn't stop talking about how professional and pleasant she was after the experience! This beautiful experience with Varvara and Alexander is HIGHLY recommended as I am so touched by their great hospitality! Thank you for making our first trip to Barcelona beyond great.

We loved our afternoon with Vickie! She was informative, fun and made us feel safe. We made some great new friends and loved chatting to Vickie about the history of Barcelona. This was a highlight of our holiday and would 100% recommend you book it!

It was a really cool trip with a beautiful sunset and super nice hosts and guests!
They had cava, beer, and some tapas. So a nice birthday gift when you are traveling in Barcelona:)

Fantastic pair to sail with for sunset they make you incredibly comfortable and ensure everyone is at ease. Plenty of beverages and snacks on offer blankets the works. Their knowledge of the area is brilliant without being fake and will get to know you and make recommendations for the rest of your trip. Will recommend to all my friends when in town!
The trip was very nice and very relaxing and the company was very good. Thank you for the good humor! If you are looking to relax onboard, I recommend this experience
a simple journey that is greatly different from other things that are done in the city, excellent hosts!!
Fun experience sailing out in the harbor with Vicky as skipper. She gave us lots of insight about Barcelona and the food and drink was high-quality.

The experience was great, cap was great and very nice and knowledgeable... the only thing was, what we couldn't account for, the weather at that time and the sea was a bit 'wavy' lol but she was great and handled everything very well and informed us when we could go onto the bow and when we should come back.

Cannot recommend this experience enough!!!!! The boat is gorgeous, and the views are unmatched. Lies was a fabulous host and captain - full of stories, humor, and great music. The unlimited cava, wine, and tapas are fun too. This was the perfect way to spend our afternoon in Barcelona. Thank you Lies for everything!!!!

Victoria was our captain for the day, and she was great! She knew lots of interesting things about the harbor and about Barcelona itself, and made sure that everyone was comfy and had enough to snack on and drink. The views were really nice, even when it was overcast, and it was a fun little side adventure for our day.
We had an awesome time with Lies and Vicky. The tour was fun, the Cava more than tasty and our two skippers were super sweet and fun. We would recommend the tour 100 percent!

The sunset boat tour was a super fun highlight of our long weekend! Lies and Viki were our skippers and they were truly the best part of the experience! The weather was rough but they made it a memorable experience and were very attentive every step of the way. I highly recommend booking and if you’re lucky, you will have one of these awesome skippers and lots of cava!
We loved the sailing experience, our tour guide Vicky was fantastic. The day was cloudy, it did not ruin our experience, we were still able to enjoy the views and experience.
It was a great experience to see the sunset and have great views of the Barcelona Coast. They provided food and drinks, and their company was lovely!

The atmosphere on the boat was very nice. Also the little dog is very cute.
Drinks and snacks are also available.
Unfortunately only one activity in good weather and for people who do not quickly become sea sick.
In summary, a very successful trip. :)

The best experience ever!! This was our third time in Barcelona, but this sailing trip made it extra special and is such a lovely memory!! I can recommend it to everyone. Despite the fact that it was still cold at the beginning march we could sit on the deck with a glass of wine. The hosts are the nicest and most welcoming people ever. It was the best birthday suprise for my husband :)

My partner and I had so much fun on this sunset cruise for our first visit to Barcelona. It was a choppy day but they made sure that we were safe and comfortable! Our hosts were super friendly and professional and we had an excellent time. Its great to see the city from this vantage point! Highly recommend!
