Vicky was great and attentive to the group. Explained everything clearly and she let all the guest enjoy their time on the boat. Would definitely recommend.

Very nice experience. Pity it was a bit cold... a rather big temperature difference with just walking in the city. ;-) Luckily the skipper provided us with blankets, but even then... remember to dress warm!
We had a wonderful time on the sailing trip with Vicky. She personalised the experience and ensured to answer any questions we had.

We had so much fun on our cruise. Peter was so incredible, poured our drinks for us, had snacks laid out, gave us blankets because it was chilly, and was very knowledgeable about the area. We met new friends from around the world while on our cruise and ended up getting drinks after for several hours. Couldn’t have had a better time!

I had a blast sailing. Vicky was an excellent captain, full of stories, and really made the experience an exceptional one. It was a beautiful day with lots of wind and we were able to really move once we were out in the open water. I’d definitely do it again!

This experience was my best moment in Barcelona. Varvara is the sweetest host, and made the environment on her boat very warm and friendly. I would recommend this specific experience highly, as it made the trip the best that I’ve ever been on (and I’ve been traveling for years).

Great experience, totally new to me. Super nice skipper: Vicky.
My son loved it. He had to participate. Really great.

Victoria was amazing!! I am 110% going to be coming back once I'm back in Barcelona!! it's good for solo travellers to meet others :) I would highly recommend this experience to anyone and everyone. She makes it enjoyable for everyone no matter what your age is!

We loved our sunset sailing experience! Even though it was chilly, the skipper provided a blanket and we were able to sit back and relax. There were 10 guests total on the trip, which felt a bit crowded, but still enjoyable. The crew did a fantastic job navigating and making us feel comfortable!
Entertaining sail even in light winds. Captain made the adventure fun and first mate provided excellent suggestions on restaurants and other activities during our travel.
Beautiful isn’t enough to describe this experience. Cold (February) weather but still just as enjoyable with the sun shining right at us! Very knowledgeable and fun skippers as well.
It was a very nice experience, the people who led sailing were very attentive and concerned. The bad thing is that it was only in English when it was also Spanish

great experience the skipper (edouardo) was great the walk is long enough to enjoy the beautiful view of the city of Barcelona as well as at sunset.
excellent, no complaints.
An amazing experience with Eduardo. Very attentive skip with a touch of humor, we met beautiful people in a beautiful environment. The sunset was very beautiful, we had a good time.

Great boat tour!! Eduardo is a great captain with a lot to say
We can get as many drinks as we want and some Spanish snacks as well
Very friendly skipper (Eduardo) as well as his chef (Alexander). It's a very pleasant experience to have. We also really enjoyed the aperitifs and the drink service!

We enjoyed a magical boat ride along the Barcelona coast. We were fortunate that it was only us so we had the boat to ourselves. The captain was welcoming and funny. He made us feel right at home by bringing out drinks and snacks for us. He was nice enough to let us drive the boat for a little bit. It was such a wonderful experience, we will cherish it.
awesome boat trip, we got lucky enough to have the boat to ourselves. Great views and the weather was on our side 👌 highly recommended.

We had a great time with our Captain Eduardo. He was great at letting us know what to expect and providing safety instructions. There wasn’t much wind but it was a beautiful day out and Eduardo made sure to help us make the best of it. I would definitely recommend this excursion and will be doing it again on my next trip to Barcelona.
I really recommend it for solo travellers, it’s a nice way to socialise whilst seeing some great views, I had such a nice time and everyone was really friendly! Special thanks to Victoria our skipper
Victoria was amazing, great personality and friendlyness! Got a couple of good recommandations and a personalized trip! I'm really happy we went on the tour!

This was a wonderful way to watch the sunset from the water! I was a solo traveler (in the winter) and still had the best time meeting the other couples on board and Ian, our skipper. He was super nice and personable and made the experience even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!

This experience is a must! beautiful scenery. But the best of the journey was Vick, our sailor. She was extremely thoughtful, kind and provided us with the best of the experience.. It's also a good place to make new friends.

Vickie was knowledgeable and so kind! We came with 3 young kids and she was so accommodating and involved them in the sailing. I cannot imagine a better experience seeing the Barcelona coastline. The sunset was absolutely stunning.

This was such a pleasant afternoon! Enjoying the winter sun from the water was such a magical adventure. Our captain was Victoria- she was such a friendly host, and told stories from her impressive sailing background as well as gave many insightful tips on how to make the most of our time in Barcelona. Definitely want to go again!
Victoria was absolutely amazing!! Such a sweet & intelligent Skipper/host. I really enjoyed this experience. Sending friends & followers your way ! Very professional
The experience was great! It was so nice sailing with Eduardo. He provided us with wine and food and we had the best talks. We had a wonderful trip and will for sure come back!

Do you want to enjoy a beautiful sunset, a romantic, cozy moment? Then this is the chance! It was very pleasant, seeing Barcelona at sunset is really WOW! The host was also very friendly, as well as the captain! We enjoyed it and experienced a new magical moment. Really top!

What a delightful experience!! Some might think sailing in a small yacht in January is crazy but we had a delightful time with the other guests and the skipper on board. Great music, conversation, views and atmosphere. Definitely a worthwhile experience! If you go in the winter definitely dress warmly as the sunsets it’s gets significantly chilly.

A great way to spend an evening in Barcelona. We had Mark as our skipper and he made all the difference with this experience. I would recommend this to anyone looking to get away from the tourism and see a view of the city that not many people get to see!

We had such an amazing experience with Mark and Rumba. A beautiful evening out on the water as the sun set. Mark was so kind, knowledgeable, hospitable and great fun. Highly recommend for a nice night out of the city and to see Barcelona from a different perspective :)
We had a wonderful sailing experience with Ian! He was a great host and we met a couple on the boat who we ended up going out to dinner with later that evening! Beautiful sunset! Thanks!

I had a great time on this tour, our skipper was very nice and friendly, and the views were incredible. I’m traveling alone but I felt perfectly at ease on this trip so I would highly recommend it for anyone who loves the sea 🌊

We had a lovely time with our skipper Ian. Our group was small and although we arrived as strangers we left as friends and even met up for dinner another day. If you’re thinking about doing this experience I highly recommend it. We were picked up and taken to the boat where the wine was flowing. We had a wonderful time. I can’t wait to do it again!

We had an excellent time aboard the yacht watching the sunset on Barcelona. We made full use of the complementary cava and made friends with the other travellers on board, so much that we ended up continuing the night afterward with everybody. Money well spent!

This was the best value by far! Fantastic drinks and snacks, great friendly host, and the opportunity to make new lifelong friends from around the world. The boat ride may have ended, but the party didn’t after!

we had so much fun! the sunset was gorgeous, there were snacks and drinks on board, and we left with so many new friends and went out together afterwards as a group. if youre going in winter like we did, make sure you dress warmly. the winds are very cold!
Super great time! Even during this time the weather was great, host was great and offered everyone food & drinks. Highly recommend !

We did a midday cruise since it was a little chilly the day we went. The captain of the boat was very friendly and attentive to all guests. He made sure to point out how to safely navigate the inside of the boat so that we don't fall out trying to take picture at the front. Overall the experience was very nice!

Definitely the best experience I have had during my visit to Barcelona. The crew was exceptionally warm, knowledgeable and very entertaining. We ended up making friends with the other guests and even spent the rest of our time in Spain together. I would highly recommend this trip to anyone visiting Barcelona

Our skipper Mark was amazing! Funny, knowledgeable, and personable! We met 5 others on the boat and enjoyed a couple bottles of white wine. Finding the meeting point is not the easiest and the host, Vavara, never responded to my inquiries even to this day so don’t expect any assistance. Overall a great experience.

Took a bit to find the meeting point but the directions we got were super helpful. Ian, our guide was super friendly, funny, and we had a fantastic sail with an incredible view of Barcelona! Highly recommend this to anyone who wants to do something on the water in Barcelona, it rocked

Booking this sail was the best spontaneous decision I’ve taken! Everything was much better than expected, Victoria our skipper was extremely friendly and fun! She took good care of us. On top of that, the people we got to sail with were very nice and this made it more fun. Don’t get me started on the view itself, everything was absolutely beautiful! I highly recommend this experience to everyone, it’s definitely worth the price.

I highly suggest you take this cruise for a fun evening activity. We had a chill, fun group on our boat and the skipper was so kind and fun to talk to! We had wine, cava, beer, water, etc. the views were stunning and the sunset was unmatched. You need to do this.

A gorgeous evening sail out into the Barcelona seas in a beautiful yacht with glasses of cava and cheese, and lots of opportunities to take ig worthy photos as the sun sets. And meeting beautiful people travelling from all over. What more can you ask for?

What a magical day! The boat is gorgeous and it’s was a perfect day. We were extra lucky because of the great conditions (sun, clear blue sky, just me and my boyfriend and the crew). The crew, Mark and Lies, were very friendly, knowledgeable and good fun. They made sure we had the best experience: full glasses, cheese and salami, our own music on the background, answered all our questions about sailing and I was allowed to navigate the boat. I loved it all and I’m even inspired to go on a sailing holiday. I can recommend this experience to everyone. We live in barcelona and it’s very impressive to see the city from the water⛵️

My sister and I did a sunset tour during our stay in Barcelona and it did not disappoint! We lucked out and were the only guests and got to enjoy a private sail with Vicki and Sima. Both of them were great company to have and we really enjoyed the conversations. Would definitely recommend.
This was a magical last stop on our trip! Everyone had a great time and we even made new friends and connections. Recommend to anyone wanting to explore Barcelona and meet new people.
Honestly best boat ride ive ever had. Cruising down the Mediterranean at sunset is definitely one for the books. Great activity to book while in Barcelona

So grateful to join this amazing experience which gave me a good taste of sailing.
additionally the crew members are very welcoming and friendly.
Wonderful, relaxing experience. 10/10 recommend to anyone looking to see the Barcelona coastline and make some new friends at the same time. Thank you Sima and Marc, you were amazing hosts!!

This was an amazing way to spend an evening in Barcelona! We met new people and had an amazing time with the captain Mark and Sima! They were a wonderful team and kept us all entertained and having a great time! Would definitely recommend this experience to everyone!
It was a great experience that sailed out at the first day of 2022. The weather was perfect and the staffs were fantastic. I would recommend more friends for joining such adventure.

Super great experience sailing at sunset! I went solo which can be a little awkward, but everyone was super friendly and inviting. Plenty of wine & cheese, good conversation, and of course amazing views. Would definitely sail again next time I’m in Barcelona.

First-class, light-hearted, beautiful experience. Liked the mix of nationalities and life stories. Captain Varvara and Mate Simi were fun and helpful. Wonderful way to see the city, as well as those HUGE yachts you see sitting in the private harbour. Definitely a good value, and something you'll always remember.

A lovely trip on a yacht, highly recommended. I enjoyed steering the boat and the good conversations with the hosts. My only issue would be that the boat was a little cramped with 12 people. Other than that, it was a very nice day out. Thank you.

Wonderful day. Great way to relax in Barcelona. Directions to location were perfect. Cava flowed all day. Skipper was so thoughtful and caring.
Highly recommend!!!
Just book and join. Beautiful way to see Barcelona from the water and have a nice time with good people

Our family sail was a priceless memory, a beautiful afternoon on the water. Tasty snacks, good company, and fun sailing - we enjoyed meeting our skipper Eduardo and would book the trip again. For the best experience, pick a day that is sunny and windy!
The sailing with Victoria as captain was truly magical. Very considerate, discreet and with a great sailing experience, it was like going out with a friend ! Noon sailing was really great.

Trip was very nice. Skipper Victoria was suuper cool, we enjoyed her stories very much. She was super professional, hospitable and caring. We learned lot of interesting fasts about sailing and the history of Catalonia from her. We also had a nice Cava on the boat and the sneaks. We recommend this experience for sure.
Vicky was a great host and extremely knowledgeable about Spanish culture. We had a great time sailing during the sunset and would definitely come back.

Beautiful experience
Highly recommended, attention above all.
You can see the Mediterranean in all its splendor, it is an incredible activity to do in Barcelona.
Very nice boat ride, Vicky puts us at ease and sails very well it was a pleasure and we will come back for sure
Great experience! Our host made sure we had plenty of drinks and snacks on the ride and we enjoyed a beautiful sunset on the water.

A huge thank you to Ian (our skipper and host for the event) for being absolutely amazing. I was fortunate enough to join a very intimate amount of people who all happened to be travellers, which was a great way to get to know each other. The sunset was beautiful, despite the not-so-favourable weather. The entire experience was amazing and I highly recommend! Will be back again soon.
The weather was bad, though the staff tried the best too, appreciate their efforts. But the weather is just not appropriate for a sailing in my opinion, it was raining and cold

Richard, the guide and captain, has a great sense of humor and is very caring. The weather was a bit bad, but thanks to Richard it was fun. I love boating so much that I am satisfied just to be on the boat. If the weather is nice, I think it will be the best experience

What a treat this was! If you’re visiting Barcelona in the winter, don’t be afraid to get out on the water. The blankets and multiple glasses of cava on board made for an awesome couple of hours of sailing. It was a refreshing vantage point of a beautiful city.

This. Was. AWESOME! We had the perfect skipper/captain Ian. He was obviously an expert, so we felt safe and comfortable during the trip. But he was also the perfect host! This was a relaxing yet upbeat experience. I highly recommend it!

Ian was a great host and skipper. He made my family and I feel welcomed, safe, and comfortable. My 6 and 10 year old sons loved the experience and it is definitely worth the rate, a great value for what we paid.

Our first but definitely not last Airbnb experience! This was such a highlight of our Barcelona trip. The skipper Eduardo was incredibly personable and attentive. Thank you for an amazing time on the sea! The jamón, queso, & cava were all appreciated :)

The Barcelona Sunset cruise was relaxing. The weather was lovely and seas were calm for mid-December. We met great people and Eduardo was a great captain. The glimpse of the sunset could have been longer. The tapas and Cava were awesome.

What a wonderful unforgettable evening we had! The team was easily reachable for communication, very well organized, they did a great job at making us feel comfortable.
We experienced a magical sunset on this lovely cruise! ⛵️
As a plus, me and my husband were alone so it was a private experience for us.
Would totally recommend! ❤️
Beautiful ride with beautiful view! Skipper was lovely and so were other passengers. She was very attentive and informed, great conversation. Would recommend for a simple sunset on the water

A perfect way to spend an afternoon if you like boats and sailing. Ian was a great skipper and we felt very safe (it was very windy!!) he was also very friendly and fun and his English was excellent. All in all a very enjoyable experience and good value for money .

It is our first and the best experience in Airbnb. The trip was super-perfect! Our crew in this trip - Viktoria - is very friendly, warm and wise woman, very interesting companion and also a professional skipper! The trip was very safety. Highly recommend the sailing on yacht with company and partners of Varvara.

Even on a cloudy day, the sea was beautiful and it was well worth the money. I can’t recommend this experience enough, we all enjoyed ourselves immensely. Thank you!!

This was one of the highlights of my trip to Barcelona! I love being on the water and it was a perfect day for sailing. Our hosts were so gracious and very friendly. The cava kept flowing and the tapas were an added bonus. Highly recommend!

Awesome experience! We had beautiful weather, the boat was great, as well as the hosts. Mark was our skipper and he was super personable. He let us help sail and answered all of our questions. Cheers!
The experience was amazing and just as advertised! I would strongly recommend going with a group as that makes the whole adventure more wonderful!

We had a great sailing trip, with the skipper Alin, not the person Varvara who hosts this experience. Just want to make it clear that the listed host was not present at all, which was not a problem except I feel the positive review has nothing to do with her. The boat was clean and we were impressed by Alin’s
knowledge and willingness to include us in sailing activities. We were lucky enough to be the only people who booked the tour so it was relaxed and fun. We really enjoyed the experience overall!

We had an amazing journey with Varvara and some lovely cava to accompany the incredible views from the water :) we had a fantastic time relaxing to the lull of the waves and would totally recommend this experience to anyone!

It was a nice day on the boat. The gentleman and his girlfriend (and cute dogs) were very friendly! Only issue was it was difficult to find the meeting place and didn’t get a response from the organizer when asked for directions. But all turned out well in the end. The captain and his stories were memorable and fun!

My sister and I truly enjoyed this experience. The group was small enough to make us feel private and to bond with the few other participants. Everyone can sit where they feel comfortable. There’s an atmosphere of trust and chill about the whole trip. Great, we would gladly repeat. Thanks!
My mother and I had a lovely time sailing. The captain was very knowledgeable and friendly with a great sense of humor. Book this experience, it’s worth it!

I have never been sailing before. My friend and I were very lucky as the afternoon we booked ended up with just us. It was a really enjoyable two hours. That we decided to book again for the next day.

We couldn't recommend this enough - our skipper Marina was really friendly, a great sailor, and really cared about everyone having a fantastic couple of hours on the water. The meeting point is a little confusing (the entrance to the marina has no sign, but it is right on the corner by the Museu d'Història de Catalunya) but after that it was all perfect. The boat itself is gorgeous and Marina is a wonderful host, keeping everyone's drinks topped up and telling us info about the sights we're sailing past, and then giving people the opportunity to take the helm if they want to, or not if they want to just relax. We liked it so much, we booked it again for the following day!

It was such a great experience and highly recommend this over similar ones on Airbnb experience in Barcelona. The sailing was great, the drinks and food were a great touch and the captain was wonderful

This was an incredible experience! As I went in late October, I did not have the opportunity to take a swim but the day was perfect for taking a sail. We were greeted by our skipper, Allene, a very pleasant young woman from France. She was extremely friendly and a skilled captain. Very engaging and patient with her guests. Cava, white wine and plenty of snacks were available to us and she allowed us to steer the boat and help out with tasks on the boat, if we wanted to be active participants in the process, which was fun. Our tour was very small and I ended up meeting some really nice people to hang out with for the day. The only issue was the boat set sail a little later than expected. Originally scheduled for noon but was pushed back about 2 hours due to "practicalities". Sometimes when dealing with the sea, these things happen so I was understanding, however it did cause me to miss another scheduled experience. Just something to keep in mind when scheduling activities. Leaving a larger cushion in the timing may work to your advantage. Other than that, the ride was so pleasant and enjoyable and such a great way to see the beautiful Barcelona coast line from the water. When the weather is so beautiful as it was that day, it's the most amazing way to spend a couple of hours.

A perfect experience to get out of the hustle and bustle of the city. We just so happened to be the only ones on the boat that afternoon so we got a private experience, which was amazing. Alina, our skipper, was super welcoming and obviously very passionate and knowledgable about sailing. Made us want to quit our jobs and learn how to sail as well!

Amazing experience that I could not recommend more. We sailed with Mark, and he was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. He taught us about sailing, let us steer the boat and help with the sail. The views were fantastic, the boat was amazing. This was just a great time that was a highlight of our trip.

Our skipper was named “Alina”(maybe?) she was awesome! It was only us on the tour that day and she was very welcoming and friendly! She poured us glasses of cava, explained where we were going, and made us feel very welcomed. We were kind of nervous because it was only my sister and I but she made the whole experience great! Would definitely recommend.

Beautiful boat! Our host (I’m sorry, I forget her name but she was a petite French girl) was very friendly and experienced in sailing. We had a small group of only four, plus the skipper, and it was nice to hear about her background and how she came to be in Barcelona. Snacks and unlimited drinks were provided, and we were able to move around the boat freely. Unfortunately the water was rough so we were unable to sail out too far, but it was still a lovely sunny day on the water with an open bar and good company, and you can’t beat that.

My only complaints are that we booked the tour for 2:30pm and were told around 11am the day of the tour that it was being moved up to noon. As a result of the last minute change, we had to really rush from the tour we were already on that morning to get there on time. Also, the tour description states you will learn some basics of sailing, but our skipper didn’t really go over any of that (although it was pretty cool to watch such a tiny woman rock all of that stuff by herself!) Im sure she would have if we would have asked her to, though. All in all, I was happy with the experience and would recommend it.

Very nice experience! We rented the boat as a surprise for our friend and that was a great atmosphere and time we spent on the boat! The hosts are very nice and welcoming and understanding! Highly recommended!
It was my last day in Barcelona and I couldn’t have made a better choice than to take advantage of this awesome boat ride. Great time and great energy from everyone aboard.

The skipper Marc was incredible. Very pleasant personality and the soundtrack for our sail was spectacular. I enjoyed bottomless cava and the folks who joined the experience were also quite enjoyable. One of the best sailing experiences I’ve had to date.

This experience was just amazing, it felt like a once in a lifetime kind of experience! The sailing was exciting, smooth and beautiful. We all felt so welcomed and they made the experience enjoyable for everyone including my children. I would recommend this experience to everyone!

We had a great time. Our hosts were incredibly friendly. The power went by right away. And we had the chance to share this experience with other equally friendly tourists. We've had the best attention at every level. My daughters and I highly recommend this activity.

Aline was the perfect skipper! She was so delightful to spend time with and made sure we felt at home on the boat. It was nice to learn a little about her and how she ended up moving to Spain as well as her experience in sailing boats. It was my first time on a boat and it was memorable for sure! The weather was beautiful, the water was a dream and the boat was just right for our small group.

Thanks Aline for a lovely day!

A great experience! Our skipper, Aline, was wonderful & very knowledgeable. She provided us with a fun time out on the water. She even had us assist with the sailing process if we wanted. Highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Barcelona!

The whole thing was a wonderful and relaxing. Our skipper was super friendly and accommodating. The hosts were wonderful and quick to respond to queries. I only wish I did this at sunset as the view would have been even more spectacular.
Mark was very funny and kind! He made us feel very welcome. The seas were rough but he still made it enjoyable. Must try this if you are looking to get out of the busy city scene.
We had a wonderful trip!!! We didn’t want it to end. Our hosts were so kind and knowledgeable. If I’m ever back in Barcelona, will definitely do this again!!

Great lil adventure on a pretty sailboat. Definitely a cool adventure, but be prepared to be flexible! It seemed a little chaotic at times - but such is life when you’re at sea. The hosts were very kind, friendly, and funny.

Really friendly guys, and an overall lovely experience! Not a private experience but it didn’t bother us at all, was really nice to talk to the other couple on the boat (a total of 5 gusts and 2 hosts/skippers). Lovely snacks & drinks, you get loads of time to sunbathe and chill on your own at the front of the boat. Would highly recommend
We were blessed with beautiful weather and calm seas. This was a great way to sit back and enjoy the Barcelona sunshine and blue seas.

Just got off the yacht, Alexander and his father looked after us very well and guided us through everything that was going on during the experience. They let members of the cruise get up and steer the yacht and assist with the use of the sails. Beautiful views of the area and a beautiful part of the ocean to be in.
Overall a great way to spend a few hours of an afternoon in Barcelona!

The trip was awesome! It was hard for me to get my big group to decide on what we wanted to do but everyone is so happy we did this! It is a unique and beautiful experience. Such kind people, great cava, and even better company. I recommend this 110%!!! They taught us a little about sailing and let us relax and enjoy the views. Definitely do this if you want a cool experience in Barcelona!
Great experience that allowed you to see Barcelona from a different perspective. Highly recommend if you want to get away from all the tourist. Loved every second of the experience.

Alexander and Michel were very kind, caring and hospitable hosts eager to share their passion for sailing. We lucked out with the weather that it wasn’t too choppy on the water. Both gentlemen were great about pointing out the major sites on land and gave great hints on where to get great views after our sailing experience. The only regret we had was that it wasn’t longer. Book this experience without any hesitation.

While not private, this is an excellent sailing experience for sailors and non-sailors alike. In a mixed group of ~12 people, we got to enjoy two hours on a beautiful, modern and well-kept Dufour 412 sailboat, skippered by Mark, a very skillful helmsman and wonderful host.

During this experience, you'll get to enjoy a few drinks while enjoying views of Barcelona from the sea, meet other travelers and heck, take the helm if you wish to.

It was nice to introduce myself to Mark as a fellow sailor and assist with getting in and out of the slip, hoisting sails and more. For me, it felt really rewarding to serve as crew on a sailboat as lovely as this one and yes, I felt I could tick off that "sailing on the Mediterranean" achievement with flying colors :)

Overall, while there are many sailing tours on offer in Barcelona, the convenient location of this one (Port Vell) and the quality of the boat make this one a very pleasant half-day out. I'll have to come back during the summer, to enjoy swimming in the Med, too!

This was one of the best trips I have done! It was absolutely incredible it was my favorite thing I did in Barcelona by far. I really enjoyed getting to know more of the sailing techniques and enjoying the sun! Will do again if I ever get the opportunity!

If you want to experience BCN in a completely different way, this is it!
Had a ton of fun, the boat is beautiful, Marc is a great host and skipper.

Thank you Mark! Me and my friend had the best time on the boat. It was super sunny and we could enjoy the wine on the deck. We could also actually sail the boat pretty much independently as a group but I still always felt safe with Mark being there as the pro. It felt really special being out in the sea almost on our own just having a short break from the hectic city. Would recommend for everyone!

This was a unforgettable experience! I would strongly recommend it to everyone. Marc, the sailor learned us how to sail and he was super passionate about it. It was a beautiful trip full of action, wine, good stories, nice people and lots of sun :) A pure magical moment.

It was one of my favourite adventures - we could chill out enjoying the sun, the wind, the views and some pleasant wine, but we also had a chance to learn some basics of sailing, pulling and releasing ropes and steering the wheel. Mark, who was our captain, made the atmosphere so natural that it was pure pleasure discussing a variety of topics and listening to his unusual life stories. Most of all, however, I am very thankful for being so patient with me as I got lost on the pier, waiting for me and assisting to finally make it to the yacht. Who knows perhaps one day I will make use of Mark's expertise and do some more serious sailing? Thank you for inspiring me!

Mark our Captain was a well travelled, interesting and knowledgeable man. He had lots of suggestions on places to go and made our view of Barcelona from the sea an experience I'd be sure to do again.

It was unfortunately too cold to dive in for a splash but enjoyed the sail nevertheless. Expected a bit more from the food/drinks offered but would still highly recommend it regardless

We had a lovely time with Mark on the boat . We got lucky and had the boat all to ourselves and a scenic view . Mark was very laid back and knowledgeable about Barcelona . He even served us snacks and beers . A very relaxing and wonderful journey .

This Experience, has been the very peak and Highlight of my trip to Barcelona. Didn’t think much else could top a Boat ride on the Mediterranean but the AMAZING Company, knowledge and Charisma of the Skipper and crew made it such a fun & memorable ride.
Lots of laughter, good conversations, good food and drinks. Breathtaking views and many great Photo Opportunities. I enjoyed the little bits of Sailing Information from the Skipper and learning a bit about the Boat used, the port, surrounding boats and geography etc.
I really enjoyed this experience and wish I could give it a 6 star rating. 😊
To Mark, the Skipper. Thanks for an excellent, fun and heartwarming experience. Surely one of my all time fav memories!! 👍

This was the best experience of my whole trip!!!! The one thing I was dying to do was be on a sailboat on the ocean. Aside from sailing on the beautiful Mediterranean it was the people that made this experience so special. I was late because my uber dropped me off in the wrong spot, they waited for me and guided me to the correct place. When I got there they were so kind and made me feel at home. Mark and Miriam were so amazing!! You can pick any tour and have an experience on a boat, but its rare to find people that make the experience extraordinary. So happy to have met them!!

From start to finish this experience far exceeded my expectations! Beers were cold. The skipper was friendly, helpful and experienced! He allowed us to be involved as much or as little as we wanted. He did a great job teaching and explaining to us about the boat, sailing and Barcelona! I had never sailed a sailboat before and really enjoyed the hands on experience as well as a time to sit back, relax, and take in the views with a beer and my partner.

This was a really great activity. i say activity, because you actually participate in something. You can help with the sailing and feel like you are an active part in the boat operations...and thats exactly what we wanted. The only negative point i want to make, there were no tapas as indicated on the description (and that might have bothered some people)...but we didnt care since we were having such a good time and actually felt very busy and engaged throughout the 2 hour trip. Also a note, the guide/captain could not have been more friendly. He was amazing.

It's a really nice experience, nice weather, kindly people, and we steer wheel for a while!
Very interesting experience, good weather, very kind English uncle and Spanish guy, we also tried to drive our own sailboat for a while!
Marc and his lovely wife, Miriam was absolutely lovely and a wonderful host. We really enjoyed our sailing experience and can’t wait to come back soon and do it all over again.
Mark was a great captain and host. He took care of us, and provided a fun and safe environment, as well as incredible stories of his nautical experiences. The boat was clean and beautiful.
Very pleasant experience. I recommend it. I learned how to navigate. I moved the candles and handled the helm of the boat. Better than I expected
This was a highlight on our trip to Barcelona! Mark was very knowledgeable and great company. The boat was beautiful and provided a great view of the ocean and the city. Would highly recommend!
Mark and Forest were super friendly. We had drinks and snacks then a refreshing dip in the sea. The view was breathtaking. Felt super safe in their hands.

I was skeptical about booking a tour through air bnb for the first time. However, my boyfriend and I were extremely happy that I did! You begin to realize quickly you are helping to support local people and business booking through air bnb. Marc, our skipper, was extremely friendly and knowledgeable about sailing. He genuinely trusted us to help him steer and sail the boat with him. We got to enjoy beautiful views while learning a great deal about sailing itself. He even gave us great advice on what to do in town. Not only did we have an amazing experience on the beautiful Mediterranean Sea, but we now also have made a new friend! Thank you Marc for this experience and if you are interested you MUST give this a try! 10/10.
What an amazing experience! Mark was fantastic, a total pro. I highly recommend this to anyone who likes water, relaxing, sailing, and good company!

Disappointing. The experience description specifically highlights being able to learn more about being on a boat and being able to ask questions but our captain didn’t have enough command of English to communicate more than a few basic concepts. The group eventually gave up trying and settled in for a regular boat tour. I don’t blame him for that because it seems like he was a last minute substitution after the company delayed the tour by two hours from the original start time and changed the location to a different dock. Then the captain wasn’t able to make it and be ready to sail until 45 minutes after the delayed start time. Perhaps there were circumstances beyond their control but it was a poor experience.

I went out with Mark - truly a fantastic experience. He let me take over some of the jobs and I learned quite a bit about sailing terms and "the rules of the road". It was a good amount of learning for my first time, not too much! Mark was also wonderful conversation for local tips and incredible stories- ask him about the long distance walker with the bamboo bike! There truly is no better way to see Barcelona than from the sea. I will return for another lesson soon :)

We took this experience with my wife on our trip to BCN and were really excited not only about the sailing itself, but a promise we could take part of the crew activities as well. We got to raise sails and all, and of course a swim in clear blue waters was a crown on top of the experience. The hospitality of Mark and his family was very warm and welcoming. We had absolutely great time and can highly recommend this experience to anyone interested sailing/swimming/chilling.

We had such a wonderful time sailing with Mark and his crew/family. They were very genuine, warm, and welcoming. This experience was a highlight of the trip during our time in Barcelona. Sailing the beautiful blue Mediterranean Sea with good music, good company, and good wine was a magical experience. There was even an adorable dog named Rumba who joined us and we loved having her on board. We even stopped to swim in the Sea which felt so amazing and therapeutic. The boat was also in great condition and we would have been happy to book this for an even longer experience. We felt taken care of from beginning through end. Thanks for such a special experience!

Amazing! Oh my goodness. They were so nice and their boat was lovely. I wish I had taken this excursion on my first day instead of my last because they were full of good tips about places to go for music and what not. And the sea is perfect, so gorgeously blue. Love!

It was absolutely amazing! I had a great time for my 25th birthday! Mark and his wife was extremely nice and informative and we had great conversations! They also spoke English very well and gave us yummy wine and treats! If and when I do come back I will be requesting them for a second time!!! Thank you Mark!!!!!

Was lucky enough to be the only person on board with Mark, Miriam and Rumba on our sailing trip. A beautiful Vessel and a hands on experience comfortable for those with no previous sailing background. An exceptional tour highlighted by swimming in the blue waters of the Mediterranean, and sipping a beer while helping steer the Yacht.
The host Alessandro and his mate were very welcoming. Showed me the best sides a city could offer. They also explained to me a lot about sailing and it was very cool to see it in action
We had a lovely time on this beautiful sailboat, with his very friendly skipper Mark. We even drove from the boat off Barcelona, it was great!

This is from a couple who usually hate "orgnised activities" but what a pleasant surprise! Mark and the crew were fab! Great atmosphere, great people and a real highlight to our quick stop in Barcelona. Exactly like owning your own 42 foot yacht and popping out for a few casual hours on the water. Can’t recommend the experience highly enough. Big 5* and a big thank you to Mark and co.

:-)

We had a great time sailing with Mark this weekend! He was so friendly and accommodating, and his boat is beautiful. The swimming part of the trip was so fun! He gave us goggles and pool noodles and the water was so clear and blue. I highly recommend this trip to anyone coming to Barcelona! Definitely a highlight

This was an excellent experience! I went with several of my friends and we had probably the best day of our trip. The boat is clean and in a really nice port. Mark was fantastic; we got to participate in the sailing and were able to play our own music. We sailed a couple miles off the coast then went for a swim. On the sail back we laid down in the bow and just relaxed. Highly recommend the experience!
Even though the weather (high winds) did not cooperate, Mark made it work and enjoyed my time. He offered to take folks on another outing.

The hosts on the boat were funny, genuine, charismatic, and all around fun people to be around. They gave all of us many opportunities to steer the boat or just help with some smaller sailing things. The only problem was that they offered us drinks but never any tapas, as was promised, but it wasn't a big deal.

My fiance and I loved the sailing experience! It was great to see the city from a different perspective, and in July the weather was beautiful for an afternoon on the sea. Mark was an entertaining host and captain. Neither of us had been on a sailboat this large before, and we really enjoyed seeing how the boat worked.

Amazing experience, mark was great and very accommodating. The yacht and the trip were breathtaking. There were a few different groups on the same charter, but that did not make it any less of a great experience!

This was an absolutely beautiful boat to spend a few sunny hours on. Sailing along the coast gives great views of a lovely city. Mark is clearly an experienced sailor who makes you feel very comfortable and welcome aboard his boat. He's willing to share his knowledge if you're interested. We highly recommend fitting this experience into your trip.
Mark took us out on his boat for a great scenic view of Barcelona. Was a great way to see the city and a worthwhile experience

Mark was absolutely incredible and the boat was beautiful!! I couldn't find him for the cruise when it left at Noon. I called Mark and he was encouraging me not to worry, and asked if I could meet him that same night at 6p. I did so and we went out with another couple. Mark was really amazing and I cannot thank him enough for scheduling me in! Thanks, Mark!

We had an absolutely lovely day on the water with Mark. I grew up sailing with my family but hadn’t been out sailing for 10+ years. Mark was gracious, charming, and funny and he made sure everyone on the boat (all 3 of us) had an opportunity to steer. He explained all the sailing basics and was happy to clarify and correct if there was any confusion. Truly an amazing time. Definitely recommend for anyone looking for a quick lesson in sailing in a gorgeous setting with someone who clearly loves what he does.

Mark was a great guide. Charming and funny. Would highly recommend to anyone looking to kick back for a bit, enjoy the sea, and learn a bit about sailing. Drinks and snacks we'lre included which was an unexpected treat. Thanks for a great time!

The boat is absolutely gorgeous and the view of Barceloneta from the sea is breathtaking. Marc is a very comfortable and humorous person to learn from and converse with. This experience has been the highlight of my trip. Thank you Marc!

Mark did a phenomenal job with the three people in my experience group, from the time we left Port Vell he had us steering, performing some basic sailing maneuvers and instructing us on the mentality behind when to tack or jibe. He was kind enough to show us around his beautiful sailing yacht once we were out on the sea, and was an excellent casual conversationalist with all of us. As a scuba diver, I talked with Mark about scuba diving experiences in the Caribbean and he made a recommendation for a scuba liveaboard operation off of Cuba that I fully intend on doing in the future. Despite our light wind on the day, Mark made sailing around outside Port Vell an engaging educational experience that I would love to do again.
This was a great experience. Mark was very patient with the guests and answered all the questions we had. The boat was great, very clean and easy to sail. I recommend this experience!

A really enjoyable couple of hours sailing a modern cruising yacht in beautiful waters. Our skipper Mark was very friendly and very much a “people person”. He invited us to take part in as much or as little as we wanted onboard. Some lay on deck enjoying the sun while others helped raise sails and were invited to take the helm/steer. There was a selection of drinks and snacks provided, and the particular yacht we were on was only 2 years old. It was a very relaxed atmosphere and for us the highlight of our 3 day trip to Barcelona. It does pay to be slightly flexible with timings on the day as it seems they may differ to what was originally booked. Overall a fantastic experience!

This sailing trip with our skipper Mark was a fantastic experience. We were a family of 7 representing 3 generations. Mark was a hit with all. He let the youngest, 11 years old help put up the mast. Mark's humor and intelligence made the interaction so much fun for all of us. Our son enjoyed taking the helm as much as the 3 grandchildren. The tapas and drinks were excellent -the time flew by. I highly recommend you take this trip!

Really nice experience! The captain and skipper teach you basics of sailing if you like and have drinks/tapas included, which was great.
It was a lovely sunny day and I would recommend definitely to do it, once in Barcelona.

We had a wonderful time! Highly recommend for something different to do in Barcelona and to get another perspective of the city ! Mark and Nico were great as well, very informative and fun to talk to!
Mark was a great host and skipper, we had a blast scooting around Barcelona's harbor and sailing on th meditarainan. Highly recommend for anyone wanting to get out on the water.

Great time sailing with Mark! The weather wasn’t great but Mark really made the most of our time on the boat and it was really enjoyable. Would definitely recommend this experience. My fiancé loves sailing and was given some tasks to do on the boat and loved it! Thanks for a great time!!

Mark and Jake were fantastic. They answered all our questions, let us skip the boat for a bit, explained sailing techniques and let us relax anywhere on the boat.

Would definitely recommend to friends visiting Barcelona. You'll get a view of the city few get and the relaxing breeze from the sea was perfect for a midday break from the city.

Alex and Niko, thank you for the great experience! It was my first time ever on sail boat and I am grateful for the opportunity to learn from you about sailing and drive the boat for a while :)

This was very pleasant ride, great wine and nice company! Weather wasn't that great, so we haven't gone very far, because of the waves, but just as Alex said, we returned with smiles on our faces. I guess if we went further to the open sea, those waves would remove our cheerful smiles easily :D

Our guides were so friendly and knowledgeable. They also gave great recommendations on places to go to in the city! This experience allowed my boyfriend and I to get away from the city and relax for a bit and enjoy the breeze and the beautiful sea! We loved every second of it! Thank you Mark and Alex!!
We had a lovely sailing with very friendly people. We were told about how to sail and my husband was able to steer the boat for a while. They offered us drinks and tapas. Highly recommended

Very nice boat trip. They came to get us at the entrance of the marina at the planned time and took us to their nice Dufour 412. From there they took us out of the harbour for a nice trips during which I could helm the boat (under supervision of the captain). There were only 4 passengers so plenty of space. They offered drinks and nibbles. All and all they were nice people and we had a good time.

I will preface this review with the fact that this is my first (and consequently only so far) AirBnb "Experience" I have done, but I can still imagine that the experience I received was well beyond average.
First of all, the yacht is an elegant Dufour 42' that immediately took my breath away as soon as I hit the dock. Very well equipped for lengthy ocean passages, let alone an afternoon of pleasure-cruising.
Secondly, both the owner, Alexander, and the skipper, Mark, were excellent hosts. Very personable, witty, and helpful, the duo provided a lovely afternoon of sailing as well as beginner's lessons in maintaining proper cruising technique. As someone very interesting in the practice of sailing, they humored my curiosity without hesitation and even let me take the helm for a while.
As advertised, they provide a decent selection of tapas, including ham, olives, and cheese, as well as plentiful beer and cava. This made the perfect light picnic on the water.
Obviously, this experience is best enjoyed by those who are not prone to motion sickness, but if you want it enough, I absolutely say its worth doing regardless (I am biased, however, for I have a decent pair of sea-legs).
All in all, 5 stars for a wonderful ride, excellent hosts, and a delicious lunch! Would definitely recommend to anyone looking to se(a) Barça from a rare point of view!!
Thanks guys!

They gave us the absolute best experience. They were lovely to talk to and get to know and the two hours absolutely just FLEW by. I would definitely recommend this experience to anyone. I can’t say enough how fantastic this really is!

The views from the boat were amazing of the city. Mark was the captain of the boat and was very friendly and explained what we were seeing very well. Anyone looking for a sailing experience, I highly recommend this one!

Really nice, short sail. I have been on fishing boats all my life but not sail boats and this was a great introduction. Knowledgeable instructions and beautiful view of Barcelona that a lot of people never see!

Amazing experience... a must do in Barcelona. Into the serene water with beautiful landscapes. Ian is quite experienced and sail smoothly. Crew member were also knowledgeable, interesting and engaging. Overall outstanding. Keep rocking :)
My boyfriend and I had a great time on Varvara's boat. Her skipper Ian and crew Ira were very friendly and happy to teach us the basics of sailing. We also enjoyed the scenery and snacks on board.

We haven't been lucky with the weather at the beginning, but luckly we got a bit of warm weather before the end of the trip. Nice crew, very welcome and friendly. Nice trip I wish was longer than two hours, but I enjoyed It till It lasted.

I booked the total sailing experience a day after my girlfriend and I got engaged in Barcelona. It was a means of celebrating everything that happened the day before. Ian and his friend was very nice. We liked the fact that they were young, and surprisingly we were the only two who booked for that day! The sail itself wasn’t that exciting but that wasn’t their faults. It was cloudy, cold and rainy the day we left and my girlfriend got really bad motion sickness once out at sea. Ian was very accommodating though and tried to make her as comfortable as possible. One thing to note: We didn’t get served tapas during the trip even though it was listed we would. There was wine, water and coke offered served with potato chips. I wish we did have some lunch on the boat but the little neighborhood close to the water had some good restaurants to try. All in all, i would do this again if it was a tad bit longer, if they went other places besides just outside of the marina and if they served tapas. Other than that our trip was smooth.

Absolutely my favorite part about this entire trip! The host mark was amazing and super accommodating! This was my first time sailing and he made it special and I will always remember this trip. This trip was also where i proposed to my beautiful fiancee and the captain and his daughter made that experience one of the most memorable in my life. I highly recommend this trip to anyone who is visiting Barcelona!
The sailing trip was wonderful! It was so fun to get out on the water and to see a totally new view of the city! I would love to do it again!

Highly recommended, hands on experience with knowledgeable and super friendly hosts. Great time to be had by all from those with zero experience on a sailing boat, all the way up to those who are qualified and knowledgeable.

The dream... there's nothing quite like recharging your batteries as well as getting away from the hustle and bustle of the city and jogging in peace while admiring Barcelona. I enjoyed it a lot, although it was really very little wind that day. A big thank you to Mark and Ivy, thanks to whom I had a great time.

We got picked up by Mark and he brought us to his beautiful, French, two year boat. First the important, stuff, he offered us a beer or wine! And then of course showed us around the boat ;). Mark also explained a couple things how the boat worked (told us it couldn't tip because of lead in the sword..) so when we picked up speed of 8 knots no worries there at all! We took the helm a couple times too and all in all a great, lovely, and very relaxing trip! Would highly recommend sailing with Mark.

We did this sailing experience on a pretty windy afternoon which made for a lot of fun! From the initial meeting with Mark our skipper and Chris, his crew mate - we were absolutely thrilled with this experience! We were sailing with three other lovely girls from USA who we met as we got on the boat - great fun travelling companions! Marks knowledge was fantastic and he is such a nice, friendly guy - as was Chris, both really fun people with great senses of humour!! They both wanted to make sure we had fun but were safe too. It really wasnt brilliant weather but under Marks guidance we were all able, if we wanted, to take the wheel and sail the boat. SO much fun!!! Lovely snacks and drinks on board and after we finished we didnt rush off but stayed on the boat chatting to each other. I would absolutely recommend this experience to anyone looking for something a bit different to do in Barcelona - we would do it again in a heartbeat...and probably will when we return!!! You wont be disappointed!!

In addition, we had just arrived in Barcelona earlier in the day of our sailing experience and Varvara told us we could store our luggage on the ship if we needed to. I would not repeat this experience or recommend it to anyone else. First all, the host was not Varvara, but an associate of hers named Marc. He did a fine job skippering the boat, but not much else. He didn't really show us the "basics of sailing", besides some cursory comments. There were no tapas provided, just drinks and a couple slices of cheese.

Additionally, several times during the journey, Marc got on the phone and started speaking with a friend. It was a little awkward, and a bit rude considering we all stopped talking when this happened.

While Marc was a nice fellow, it didn't really feel like he was trying to provide an interesting sailing experience or talk to us about Barcelona. It was mostly just polite conversation. Given the other sailing options on Airbnb alone, I would pass on this experience and go with another.
